domains.summary: GDP is a blunt liveability stick. HDI, inequality, unpaid work, environment. A rising GDP can hide a falling river and a squeezed bottom quintile.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: Sustainable is a three-legged stool that wobbles
domains.summary: Sustainable is a three-legged stool that wobbles. Environment, economy, social. A mine that funds a school and kills a wetland is a trade-off, not a win-win sticker.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: Fieldwork is a method, not a picnic
domains.summary: Fieldwork is a method, not a picnic. Question, sample, bias, ethics (who you photograph). A clipboard at a beach still needs a repeatable method.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: A quadrat is a small honest rectangle
domains.summary: A quadrat is a small honest rectangle. Count in a known area, repeat, estimate. Do not only sample the pretty patch.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: A question can push a person
domains.summary: A question can push a person. Leading items, tiny n, friends-only samples. Likert scales are not magic. Ethics: consent, no creepy tracking.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: People are not scenery
domains.summary: People are not scenery. Photos of kids, sacred sites, disaster tourism. Permission and dignity. A slum tour can be a geography class or a zoo — the difference is consent and who.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: A location ping is a person
domains.summary: A location ping is a person. Phone maps, CCTV, and ‘anonymous’ mobility data can re-identify. A heatmap of worship times is a targeting tool in the wrong hands.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: Ice is a landform factory and a water tower
domains.summary: Ice is a landform factory and a water tower. U-valleys, moraines, and meltwater for rivers. Retreat is a climate tape measure. Australia’s mainland is not glaciated now; our.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: The Ring of Fire is a plate edge, not a campfire club
domains.summary: The Ring of Fire is a plate edge, not a campfire club. Convergent margins, subduction, andesite, tsunamis. Australia is mostly off the ring — Indonesia is not. Ash is a global.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: Soil is a slow factory
domains.summary: Soil is a slow factory. Horizons, parent rock, climate, organisms, time. Laterite and poor Australian soils shaped farming. Dirt is not an insult; it is a resource.

domains.subject: geography
domains.title: Zoning is a rumour made legal
domains.summary: Zoning is a rumour made legal. What can be built where. Exclusionary zoning, heritage, and ‘character’ can be a housing tap turned off. A missing middle is a policy.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A program is a recipe a machine cannot guess
domains.summary: A program is a recipe a machine cannot guess. Computers do exactly what you said, including the silly part. Ambiguity that a human would shrug at becomes a bug.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: An algorithm can live on paper
domains.summary: An algorithm can live on paper. The idea (sort these numbers by comparing neighbours) is the algorithm. Python is one costume. A bad idea in pretty code is still a bad idea.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Decomposition is cutting the monster
domains.summary: Decomposition is cutting the monster. A ‘make a game’ is not a first task. Input, state, draw, win-check are pieces. Each piece should be nameable.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Patterns are repeats with a name
domains.summary: Patterns are repeats with a name. Login screens, for-each, and ‘validate then save’ keep returning. Spotting them is faster than inventing a new wheel that is square.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Abstraction hides the engine so you can drive
domains.summary: Abstraction hides the engine so you can drive. You call print without building a printer. Too much hiding too soon and you cannot debug. Too little and you drown in bits.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Tracing is pretending to be the CPU
domains.summary: Tracing is pretending to be the CPU. Line by line, with a table of variable values. If you cannot trace a 10-line program, running it 40 times is superstition.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Debugging is a theory, not a rain dance
domains.summary: Debugging is a theory, not a rain dance. What would the world look like if X were true? Change one thing. Reproduce first — a bug you cannot repeat is a ghost story.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: The empty list is a customer
domains.summary: The empty list is a customer. Zero, one, huge, negative, unicode emoji, the user clicking twice. Edges are where software cries.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Nested loops can eat a lunch
domains.summary: Nested loops can eat a lunch. n² feels fine until n is a million. You do not need Big-O tattoos yet — you need a sense of ‘this will visit every pair’.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Pseudocode is a contract with future-you
domains.summary: Pseudocode is a contract with future-you. Keywords in plain language, indentation for blocks. It should translate, not rhyme.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A variable is a labelled box, not the number itself
domains.summary: A variable is a labelled box, not the number itself. x = 3 then x = x + 1. The name points at a value. Reassignment is allowed in Python; that is not algebra class.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Types are the kind of stuff in the box
domains.summary: Types are the kind of stuff in the box. int, str, float, bool. ‘3’ + 1 is a tantrum in Python 3. Convert on purpose (int(‘3’)).

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Booleans are yes/no, not maybe
domains.summary: Booleans are yes/no, not maybe. == tests equality. = assigns. and/or/not combine. ‘if score’ is truthy-tricky — prefer explicit.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: elif is a queue of gates
domains.summary: elif is a queue of gates. The first true branch wins. A pile of separate ifs can all fire. Order matters for overlapping conditions.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: for is ‘for each’
domains.summary: for is ‘for each’. for n in nums: visits. range(5) is 0–4. Off-by-one is the national bird.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: while is ‘until the world changes’
domains.summary: while is ‘until the world changes’. The condition is checked before each run. If you never update the variable, you invented a heater.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Indexes start at 0
domains.summary: Indexes start at 0. First item is [0]. Last is [-1] in Python. IndexError is a gift: you walked off the pier.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Lists mutate; assignment of lists is an alias
domains.summary: Lists mutate; assignment of lists is an alias. b = a does not copy. Change b and a may grin. Slice copy or list() when you need a twin.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Strings do not mutate in place
domains.summary: Strings do not mutate in place. s.upper() returns a new string. If you ignore the return, nothing happened and you will swear at the computer.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A function should do a job and often return
domains.summary: A function should do a job and often return. return hands a value back. print is a side effect. Mixing them confuses tests. None is what you get if you forgot return.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Parameters are the placeholders; arguments are the actuals
domains.summary: Parameters are the placeholders; arguments are the actuals. def greet(name): — name is the parameter. greet(‘Sam’) — ‘Sam’ is the argument. Order counts unless you use keywords.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Scope is who can see the box
domains.summary: Scope is who can see the box. A variable inside a function is local. The outside cannot peek unless you return. Global is a last resort, not a personality.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A dict is a labelled lookup
domains.summary: A dict is a labelled lookup. Keys to values. ‘Sam’ → 12. Not a sequence you always sort. Missing keys KeyError — use get or in.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: The exception name is a clue
domains.summary: The exception name is a clue. TypeError, ValueError, IndexError, SyntaxError (that one is before it runs). Read the last line first, then the file:line.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Files need a path, a mode, and a close
domains.summary: Files need a path, a mode, and a close. with open(...) as f: is the seatbelt. Encoding (utf-8) matters the day a name has an é.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: HTML is structure, not a look
domains.summary: HTML is structure, not a look. Tags nest. A heading is h1–h6, not ‘big bold’. Links need href. Images need alt or they fail people and search.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: CSS is a select-then-style machine
domains.summary: CSS is a select-then-style machine. Selectors pick nodes. Specificity is a scoring fight (id beats class beats element, roughly). Inline is a sledgehammer.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Width is a box with padding and border
domains.summary: Width is a box with padding and border. content + padding + border (and margin outside). box-sizing: border-box makes you sane. Margin collapse is a ghost story that is true.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: The DOM is a live tree; events bubble
domains.summary: The DOM is a live tree; events bubble. A click on a button happens on the button and can rise. preventDefault stops a form’s trip. querySelector returns the first match — or null.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: GET is a fetch; it should not smash
domains.summary: GET is a fetch; it should not smash. URLs, status codes (404 is a missing, 500 is the server’s bad day). GET should be safe to repeat. POST changes things.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A URL is a structured sentence
domains.summary: A URL is a structured sentence. scheme, host, path, query, fragment. https is the scheme plus a TLS story. The fragment (#) stays in the browser.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: JSON is a data costume, not JavaScript the language
domains.summary: JSON is a data costume, not JavaScript the language. Objects, arrays, strings, numbers, bool, null. No comments. Trailing commas are illegal in JSON. Keys are strings.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: An API is a promise about shapes
domains.summary: An API is a promise about shapes. If the docs say {id, name}, do not invent email and then cry. Versioning exists because promises break.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Accessibility is the product, not a coat of paint
domains.summary: Accessibility is the product, not a coat of paint. Keyboard, contrast, labels, captions. If you cannot tab to it, many people cannot use it. Alt is not ‘image123’.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Responsive is a constraint, not a shrink ray
domains.summary: Responsive is a constraint, not a shrink ray. Layouts that reflow. A 320px width is a device, not a failure. px-everything will crack.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: SELECT is a question, not a dump always
domains.summary: SELECT is a question, not a dump always. FROM a table, WHERE a filter, ORDER BY a sort. * is lazy. Names matter.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A join is a match between tables
domains.summary: A join is a match between tables. INNER keeps matches. LEFT keeps left even if right is lonely. A missing ON is a cartesian disaster.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A primary key uniquely names a row
domains.summary: A primary key uniquely names a row. Stable, unique, not a name (names change). Auto numbers or UUIDs. Composite keys exist.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Normalisation is don’t repeat yourself in rows
domains.summary: Normalisation is don’t repeat yourself in rows. A student’s address in 40 enrolment rows will drift. A students table plus a link is the medicine. Not always to the death — 3NF.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: CSV is a text format with feelings
domains.summary: CSV is a text format with feelings. Commas in fields, encodings, and Excel eating leading zeros (phone numbers). It is not a database.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Messy data is the job
domains.summary: Messy data is the job. Null vs 0 vs ‘n/a’ vs ‘-‘. Dates in three formats. Outliers that are typos vs real.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A chart can lie with a chopped axis
domains.summary: A chart can lie with a chopped axis. Start-at-zero fights, 3D bars, and pie slices for 20 categories. The question is: what claim is the picture making?

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: An average in code still needs a story
domains.summary: An average in code still needs a story. sum/count. Empty list is a crash or a lie. Outliers yank it. Median may be the honest centre.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A dataset can be a person
domains.summary: A dataset can be a person. Birthdate + postcode + gender can re-identify. ‘Anonymous’ is a claim you must earn. School projects still need consent.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A commit is a checkpoint with a sentence
domains.summary: A commit is a checkpoint with a sentence. Small, related changes. The message says why. ‘fix’ is not a sentence.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A branch is a parallel universe
domains.summary: A branch is a parallel universe. main stays shippable. You experiment next door. Merge is a conversation. Conflicts are two edits to the same lines — not a moral failure.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Names are documentation you cannot skip
domains.summary: Names are documentation you cannot skip. calc vs calculateInvoiceTotal. Abbreviations are a tax. A lie-name (tmp that lives forever) is a bug seed.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Comments say why, not what the syntax already said
domains.summary: Comments say why, not what the syntax already said. i += 1 // increment i is noise. ‘Skip header row from the council export’ is gold. Dead comments are lies.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A test is a claim that can fail
domains.summary: A test is a claim that can fail. Input, expected, actual. One assert per idea. A test that never fails is a decoration.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: A library is a dependency with a clock
domains.summary: A library is a dependency with a clock. Versions break. Pin them. Copy-pasting a mysterious snippet from 2014 can be a security hole.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Secrets are not in the repo
domains.summary: Secrets are not in the repo. API keys in GitHub are public. .env is local. Rotate if it leaked. School logins in screenshots are also leaks.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Untrusted text in HTML is a program
domains.summary: Untrusted text in HTML is a program. If you drop a comment into innerHTML, a <script> can ride along. Escape or use textContent. That is XSS.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: String-gluing SQL is a hole
domains.summary: String-gluing SQL is a hole. ‘ OR 1=1 -- is a classic. Parameterised queries exist. ORMs help when not raw-stringed anyway.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Store hashes, not passwords
domains.summary: Store hashes, not passwords. A hash is one-way (with salt). MD5 is not your friend. ‘Encrypt’ is the wrong word in the staffroom.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: HTTPS is a pipe with a lock, not a holy site
domains.summary: HTTPS is a pipe with a lock, not a holy site. TLS stops some snooping and tampers on the path. A green lock does not mean the company is kind. Phishing has https now.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Login is a session, not a vibe
domains.summary: Login is a session, not a vibe. A cookie or token says who you are next request. Steal the cookie, steal the session. Log out must actually kill it.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Validate on the server even if the form did
domains.summary: Validate on the server even if the form did. The browser is not a security boundary. A disabled button is a suggestion. Types, ranges, allowed file kinds.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Other people’s code has a licence
domains.summary: Other people’s code has a licence. MIT, GPL, school AUP. Copying a classmate’s repo is a licence of a different kind (academic integrity).

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: You can CS without a laptop
domains.summary: You can CS without a laptop. Sorting people by height is an algorithm. A bug is a person in the wrong place. This is not baby stuff — it is the idea layer.

domains.subject: coding
domains.title: Binary is places of two
domains.summary: Binary is places of two. 1,2,4,8… bits. 1010 is ten. A bit is a yes/no. A byte is 8. Everything is encodings on top (text, images).

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Price is not cost
domains.summary: Price is not cost. Cost is what you spent to make or buy it. Price is what a customer pays. Margin lives in the gap. A sale price can still be above cost and still be a bad.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Profit is leftover after the bills, not the till at lunch
domains.summary: Profit is leftover after the bills, not the till at lunch. Revenue minus expenses. Cash in the drawer is not profit if the supplier invoice is in the mail. A loss-making busy.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Cash flow is timing
domains.summary: Cash flow is timing. You can be profitable on paper and dead because customers pay in 60 days and rent is today. A loan is a cash-flow tool with a price.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A budget is a plan with numbers, not a vibe
domains.summary: A budget is a plan with numbers, not a vibe. Income, needs, wants, save. It fails if income is fiction. A budget is allowed to be ugly as long as it is honest.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Interest is rent on money
domains.summary: Interest is rent on money. The longer and the higher the rate, the more you pay. Minimum credit-card payments are a treadmill. Compare APR, not the pretty monthly number only.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Compounding is a snowball — both ways
domains.summary: Compounding is a snowball — both ways. Returns on returns. Starting earlier beats a heroic later dump in many simple models. Fees also compound (against you).

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Inflation is the silent price rewrite
domains.summary: Inflation is the silent price rewrite. The same $10 buys less later. Cash under a mattress loses purchasing power. Wages that do not move are a pay cut.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Opportunity cost is the path you did not walk
domains.summary: Opportunity cost is the path you did not walk. Choosing the concert is not choosing the shift. Money and time. ‘Free’ still costs a Saturday.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Sunk cost is gone
domains.summary: Sunk cost is gone. The ticket you already bought should not force you to sit through a bad film in a fire. Future costs and benefits decide.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: GST is 10% in Australia, with rules
domains.summary: GST is 10% in Australia, with rules. Added to many supplies. Input credits for businesses. Some food is complicated on purpose. You are not a tax agent after one path.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Income tax is a bracket story
domains.summary: Income tax is a bracket story. Marginal rates mean the next dollar can be taxed more than the first. PAYG is a withholding, not the final word. A refund is often you lending to.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Super is retirement money with a cage
domains.summary: Super is retirement money with a cage. Employer contributions, compounding, and rules about when you can touch it. Insurance inside super is a thing people forget they have — or.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: An invoice is a request with a trail
domains.summary: An invoice is a request with a trail. Who, what, how much, due date, ABN if needed. A screenshot of a chat is a weak trail. Unpaid invoices are a cash-flow event.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Unit economics is one more customer, zoomed in
domains.summary: Unit economics is one more customer, zoomed in. What does it cost to make one more coffee vs what they pay? Scaling a loss is a bigger loss.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Rent is fixed; beans can be variable
domains.summary: Rent is fixed; beans can be variable. Fixed costs sit there even at 0 sales. Variable costs walk with volume. Mix them wrong and the break-even hides.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Break-even is the ‘not losing’ count
domains.summary: Break-even is the ‘not losing’ count. How many units until contribution covers fixed costs. After that, the extra units are where profit can start (in a simple model).

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A value proposition is why they pick you
domains.summary: A value proposition is why they pick you. Job to be done, not your origin myth. Cheaper, faster, nicer, nearer, safer. If you cannot say it in a sentence, the customer cannot.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A segment is a group with a shared why
domains.summary: A segment is a group with a shared why. Not ‘people with money’. Time-poor parents vs hobbyists. Features follow the segment, not the other way round.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Competitors include ‘do nothing’
domains.summary: Competitors include ‘do nothing’. The alternative is often the status quo, or Excel, or a mum’s recipe. A SWOT that lists only two shops on the street is thin.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A lean test is a cheap question
domains.summary: A lean test is a cheap question. A landing page, a pre-order, a stall. Vanity metrics (likes) are not paid invoices. Kill ideas that fail the test.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A brand is a promise people can repeat
domains.summary: A brand is a promise people can repeat. Not a colour palette only. If the promise is ‘on time’ and you are late, the brand is a liar. Consistency beats a one-off stunt.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Price is a signal, not only a cover-charge
domains.summary: Price is a signal, not only a cover-charge. Skim, penetrate, bundle, decoy. Too cheap can scream ‘bad’. Too high without a story is empty.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A supply chain is a lag
domains.summary: A supply chain is a lag. Lead times, single suppliers, and a ship stuck in a canal. Inventory is a bet. Just-in-time is efficient until it is not.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Quality is fitness for the promise
domains.summary: Quality is fitness for the promise. A cheap charger that melts is not ‘value’. Inspection at the end is late; process is earlier. Returns are a quality metric.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A job is a set of outcomes, not a vibe title
domains.summary: A job is a set of outcomes, not a vibe title. What done looks like, who you help, what you may not do. A ‘ninja’ title without a position description is fog.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Awards are the floor, not a rumour
domains.summary: Awards are the floor, not a rumour. In Australia many jobs have a modern award: rates, penalties, breaks. Cash-in-hand under the floor is not a flex.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Super on a pay slip is not a bonus lollipop
domains.summary: Super on a pay slip is not a bonus lollipop. It is part of remuneration, paid to a fund. Check it actually arrived. Job-hopping needs consolidation later.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A resume is evidence, not adjectives
domains.summary: A resume is evidence, not adjectives. Did X, measured by Y. ‘Team player’ without a story is wallpaper. One page can be enough early on.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: An interview is two-way evidence
domains.summary: An interview is two-way evidence. STAR stories (situation, task, action, result). You are also interviewing them (safety, pay, roster). A vibe is not a contract.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A team has a task and a friction
domains.summary: A team has a task and a friction. Roles, a deadline, a way to disagree. Group marks without roles are a free-rider machine. Psychological safety is not ‘be nice’ — it is ‘you can.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Feedback is specific and changeable
domains.summary: Feedback is specific and changeable. ‘This slide’s claim needs a source’ beats ‘this is trash’. Ask for a sample of good. Separate person from work.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A dodgy request is still your name
domains.summary: A dodgy request is still your name. Falsify a timesheet, hide a safety issue, dump waste. ‘My manager said’ is not a full shield. Speak to a trusted adult/Fair Work/union paths.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: WHS is a system, not a poster
domains.summary: WHS is a system, not a poster. Identify, control, report. A wet floor without a sign is a choice. Young workers still have a voice.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A contract is the words, not the handshake feeling
domains.summary: A contract is the words, not the handshake feeling. Read hours, casual vs part-time, notice, IP. Signing is a moment. Verbal extras vanish in a dispute.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Demand slopes down, with exceptions you should not worship yet
domains.summary: Demand slopes down, with exceptions you should not worship yet. Higher price, fewer buyers, usually. A Giffen/Veblen brag is a later curiosity. Ceteris paribus is a Latin shrug:.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Supply is a willingness to sell
domains.summary: Supply is a willingness to sell. Higher price, more offered, usually. Costs, weather, and tax shift it. A drought is a supply shock for wheat.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Equilibrium is a story, not a moral
domains.summary: Equilibrium is a story, not a moral. Where supply meets demand in the model. Queues and gluts are disequilibrium. Price caps can mean shortages (and black markets).

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Market structure is how many rivals and how stuck customers are
domains.summary: Market structure is how many rivals and how stuck customers are. Perfect competition is a textbook farm. Monopoly is one seller. Most of your mall is in between (differentiation).

domains.subject: business
domains.title: An externality is a bill someone else pays
domains.summary: An externality is a bill someone else pays. Smoke, noise, bee-pollination. Markets under-provide goods with good spill-overs and over-provide with bad ones, unless policy or.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A public good is non-rival and non-excludable, in the jargon
domains.summary: A public good is non-rival and non-excludable, in the jargon. A firework show you cannot fence. Free-riders appear. That is why some things are taxed and provided together.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: One side knows more
domains.summary: One side knows more. Used cars, insurance, job interviews. Lemons markets. Warranties and reviews are patchy repairs.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Trade is a specialisation story with losers in the room
domains.summary: Trade is a specialisation story with losers in the room. Comparative advantage is the model. A shut factory is a person. Offshoring and supply risk are the 2020s footnotes.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A dollar buys a different pile of yen tomorrow
domains.summary: A dollar buys a different pile of yen tomorrow. Appreciation makes imports cheaper and exports harder, other things equal. Tourists feel it in their bones.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A bank is a risk machine with a licence
domains.summary: A bank is a risk machine with a licence. Deposits, loans, liquidity. Your savings are a liability on their book. Guarantee schemes have limits. A ‘too good’ rate is a smell.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Insurance is a pooled bet against a bad day
domains.summary: Insurance is a pooled bet against a bad day. Premium, excess, exclusions. You are paying to not be ruined. Insuring a phone yearly can exceed the phone.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: If it is not recorded, it did not happen — for the ATO
domains.summary: If it is not recorded, it did not happen — for the ATO. Receipts, dates, business vs private. A shoebox is a system if you can find things. Photos of receipts fade; backups exist.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: An ABN is an identifier, not a personality
domains.summary: An ABN is an identifier, not a personality. You need it for many invoices. Having one does not make every hobby a tax-deductible lifestyle. Personal services rules exist.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Australian Consumer Law is a floor of promises
domains.summary: Australian Consumer Law is a floor of promises. Guarantees on quality, refunds when they apply, no fake ‘no refunds’ on faulty goods. A change of mind is a different bucket.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A fake invoice is a genre
domains.summary: A fake invoice is a genre. Urgent ATO, fake supplier bank details, a CEO who wants gift cards. Slow down. Verify on a known number.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A not-for-profit still has economics
domains.summary: A not-for-profit still has economics. Surplus is allowed; it is not distributed to owners like a company dividend. Volunteers are labour with a different contract. Mission drift.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A franchise is a rented business system
domains.summary: A franchise is a rented business system. You buy a playbook and a sign. Royalties, territory, and rules about cucumbers. It is not ‘being your own boss’ in the full song.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: An online shop is logistics wearing a theme
domains.summary: An online shop is logistics wearing a theme. Photos, returns, delivery promises, and platform fees. A pretty Shopify is not a warehouse. Chargebacks exist.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A funnel is attention to money, with leaks
domains.summary: A funnel is attention to money, with leaks. Awareness, consider, buy, return. A viral video that sells nothing is a leak at the bottom. CRM is remembering humans.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A negotiation is interests, not a staring contest
domains.summary: A negotiation is interests, not a staring contest. What they need, what you need, a BATNA (walk-away). Silence is a tool. Lying is a short-term tax on the relationship.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A hustle is a business with a day job attached
domains.summary: A hustle is a business with a day job attached. Time, tax, sleep, and whether the employer’s contract allows it. A $4/h after costs is a hobby with extra steps.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: Limited liability is a legal technology
domains.summary: Limited liability is a legal technology. Companies can fail without automatically taking the owner’s house — with exceptions (guarantees, fraud). Sole traders are the business.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: CPI is a basket with politics in the recipe
domains.summary: CPI is a basket with politics in the recipe. Housing, food, fuel weights. Your personal inflation can diverge (rent vs owner). Trimmed means and living-cost indexes argue.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A minimum wage is a floor with trade-offs in the models
domains.summary: A minimum wage is a floor with trade-offs in the models. It lifts some pay. Models fight about jobs. In Australia the Fair Work Commission is a character in the story. Penalty.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A gig is a job with the risk shifted onto you
domains.summary: A gig is a job with the risk shifted onto you. No leave, a rating, a platform fee. Super and insurance can vanish unless you chase them. Flexibility is real and so is a zero-hour.

domains.subject: business
domains.title: A share is a slice; a bond is a promise
domains.summary: A share is a slice; a bond is a promise. Shares can go to zero and can pay dividends. Bonds are higher in the creditor queue, usually. Diversification is ‘do not put the rent in.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Heart rate is a message, not a score
domains.summary: Heart rate is a message, not a score. Resting rate, exercise spike, recovery. Fit people often recover faster. A low rate is not always ‘more elite’ (some conditions, some meds).

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Breathing is a muscle skill too
domains.summary: Breathing is a muscle skill too. Diaphragm, rate, and the urge from CO2. You cannot ‘hold out the CO2’ forever as a flex. Asthma plans are personal.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Growth plates are a reason kids are not small adults
domains.summary: Growth plates are a reason kids are not small adults. Bones lengthen at plates that fuse later. Heavy ego-lifting with bad form is a risk. Calcium and load (play) both matter.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Muscles pull in pairs
domains.summary: Muscles pull in pairs. Agonist contracts, antagonist lengthens. Stretch the tight side; strengthen the sleepy side. DOMS is delayed, not proof of a good session by itself.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Sleep is a performance drug that is legal
domains.summary: Sleep is a performance drug that is legal. Memory, mood, immune, growth hormone neighbourhood. Screens and caffeine are thieves. Teens often need more than they admit.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Your clock is light-trained
domains.summary: Your clock is light-trained. Morning light, evening dim. Shift-work and late phones slide the clock. Weekend jetlag is a real phrase.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Thirst is late; wee colour is a crude dashboard
domains.summary: Thirst is late; wee colour is a crude dashboard. Water, heat, and sweat. Overdrinking plain water in huge lots can be a medical mess (hyponatraemia) in endurance oddities. For.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: UV is a delayed invoice
domains.summary: UV is a delayed invoice. Burn now, damage later. Slip slop slap slide seek is still the Australian liturgy. Clouds are not a full shield. Melanoma is a young person’s disease too.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Teeth are not self-cleaning furniture
domains.summary: Teeth are not self-cleaning furniture. Sugar frequency beats one cake in a sitting for decay. Fluoride, brush, floss. Acid drinks (including ‘healthy’ juices) etch.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Vaccines train memory without the full war
domains.summary: Vaccines train memory without the full war. Antigen preview, antibodies, herd effects. Side effects exist and are watched. Andrew Wakefield is a fraud story, not a ‘both sides’.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Antibiotics are for bacteria, with a stewardship
domains.summary: Antibiotics are for bacteria, with a stewardship. Viruses laugh. Finishing a prescribed course when indicated, not ‘saving some for later’. Resistance is a community problem.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A feeling is information, not a verdict on your worth
domains.summary: A feeling is information, not a verdict on your worth. Anxiety can be a false alarm or a real one. Naming it helps a bit. Sleep, exercise, and talk are first-line for many mild.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Stress is a dose
domains.summary: Stress is a dose. A bit can sharpen. Chronic pile (school, home, phone) without recovery is a load. Control and social support change the dose.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: The phone is a stimulus machine in a bed
domains.summary: The phone is a stimulus machine in a bed. Alerts, doomscroll, and light. Notifications are designed. A charger across the room is a cheap intervention.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Feeds are not bodies; filters are not food
domains.summary: Feeds are not bodies; filters are not food. Compare-and-despair is a product. Bodies change in adolescence on a script you did not write. ‘What I eat in a day’ is often a.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Help-seeking is a skill
domains.summary: Help-seeking is a skill. Who, when, what words. Rehearse: ‘I am not OK and I need to tell you.’ If the first adult fumbles, try a second. That is allowed.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Bullying is a repeated harm with a power tilt
domains.summary: Bullying is a repeated harm with a power tilt. Not a single clumsy joke. Online is still the school’s problem when it lands at school. Record, report, do not ‘just block’ as the.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Consent is ongoing and can be withdrawn
domains.summary: Consent is ongoing and can be withdrawn. For touch, photos, dares. Silence is not yes. Being someone’s partner is not a blanket yes. Alcohol wrecks the ability to consent.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Addiction is a learning hijack, not a cartoon villain only
domains.summary: Addiction is a learning hijack, not a cartoon villain only. Dopamine loops, tolerance, withdrawal. Nicotine vapes are engineered. Gambling ads are too. You can need help without.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A plate is a pattern, not a purity test
domains.summary: A plate is a pattern, not a purity test. Veg, protein, grains, fats, water. Ultra-processed every hour is a pattern. One cake is a cake. Diet culture is a loud liar.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: How often beats how saintly one day was
domains.summary: How often beats how saintly one day was. Constant sipping of sweet drinks is a different hit from dessert after dinner. Labels: per 100g vs per serve tricks.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Salt is a hidden default
domains.summary: Salt is a hidden default. Processed food carries it. Blood pressure is a long game. Taste buds reset if you actually reset.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Fibre is not a punishment cereal
domains.summary: Fibre is not a punishment cereal. It feeds gut microbes and steadies a meal. White-only days feel different. Increase slowly with water or you invent a stomach plot.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Bacteria like warmth and time
domains.summary: Bacteria like warmth and time. The danger zone, raw chicken, cross-contamination. Reheat leftovers hot. Rice cooled wrong can be a villain (Bacillus).

domains.subject: health
domains.title: An allergy is an immune event, not a preference
domains.summary: An allergy is an immune event, not a preference. Anaphylaxis is a timer. EpiPens are not a vibe. Cross-contact in a fryer is real. Mocking a dairy-free kid can be a preference.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Caffeine is a drug with a half-life
domains.summary: Caffeine is a drug with a half-life. Sleep, heart, anxiety. Energy drinks stack sugar or sweeteners plus a dose. Kids are not small baristas.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Alcohol is a depressant that lies about being a stimulant
domains.summary: Alcohol is a depressant that lies about being a stimulant. Judgement first, then coordination. Teen brains are still wiring. Standard drinks are maths. You cannot sober up with a.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Per 100g is how you compare
domains.summary: Per 100g is how you compare. Serves are a fiction the company liked. kJ vs kcal: Australia uses kJ. %DI is for a notional adult.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A fad is a story with a before photo
domains.summary: A fad is a story with a before photo. Cutting whole groups, detoxes, and ‘eat like a cave person who also had a meal-prep company’. Weight is not the only health. Yo-yo is a.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A warm-up is a dress rehearsal
domains.summary: A warm-up is a dress rehearsal. Raise temperature, rehearse the pattern, then the intensity. Static-stretch-only then a sprint is an old costume.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Progressive overload is a little more, not a hero day
domains.summary: Progressive overload is a little more, not a hero day. Frequency, intensity, time, type (FITT). Jumping 40% in a week is a narrative, not a plan.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A skill wants reps with attention
domains.summary: A skill wants reps with attention. Blocked vs random practice, feedback, and a model. Watching 40 highlights is not 40 throws.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Rules are the game
domains.summary: Rules are the game. Cheating is a different sport. Respecting officials is a skill. Winning with a broken opponent is a loss in the only score that lasts.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: First care is not a WebMD spiral
domains.summary: First care is not a WebMD spiral. Protect, rest as needed, ice debates exist but compression/elevation still show up in first-aid teaching — follow current first-aid and a.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Concussion is chemical chaos, not only a knockout
domains.summary: Concussion is chemical chaos, not only a knockout. You can have one and still talk. Headache, fog, mood, sleep. Second hit is the nightmare. Protocols exist because of funerals.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Fitness has components that do not trade 1:1
domains.summary: Fitness has components that do not trade 1:1. Strength, endurance, power, flexibility, agility. A marathon is not a max-lift. Train the thing you want.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: DRSABCD is a order, not a slogan you shout
domains.summary: DRSABCD is a order, not a slogan you shout. Danger, response, send, airway, breathing, CPR, defibrillation. You cannot skip danger because you watched a show.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Pressure and elevation-as-taught, not a tourniquet cosplay
domains.summary: Pressure and elevation-as-taught, not a tourniquet cosplay. Direct pressure, cloth, gloves if you have them. Tourniquets are trained tools. Embedded object: pack around, do not.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Cool running water, 20 minutes, not butter
domains.summary: Cool running water, 20 minutes, not butter. Remove from source, cool, cover loosely, 000 if big/face/chemical/electrical. Butter is a folklore infection.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A choke is a silent emergency if they cannot cough
domains.summary: A choke is a silent emergency if they cannot cough. Encourage cough if they can. Back blows/chest as trained. Do not blind-finger a mouth and ram it deeper.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A plan beats a panic
domains.summary: A plan beats a panic. Know whose bag has the autoinjector, how to use the trainer, and that you still call 000. Time is the enemy.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: The water is stronger than your mood
domains.summary: The water is stronger than your mood. Rips, alcohol, night, and ‘I can swim in a pool’. Flags are a system. A hero jump with shoes on can make two drownings.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A phone is a steering-wheel thief
domains.summary: A phone is a steering-wheel thief. Reaction time, pedestrians, and the lie of ‘just a glance’. Helmets are not a fashion insult. Night + dark clothes on a bike is invisibility.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A medicine is a dose and a name
domains.summary: A medicine is a dose and a name. Paracetamol has a liver ceiling. Sharing ADHD meds is dealing, not friendship. Expired and someone else’s pills are a lottery.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Hands are a public transport for microbes
domains.summary: Hands are a public transport for microbes. Soap, 20 seconds, after toilet, before food. Sanitiser is a backup for when hands are not visibly filthy — it fails on some guts bugs.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Bodies and infections do not care about your reputation
domains.summary: Bodies and infections do not care about your reputation. STIs can be silent. Condoms reduce risk, not to zero. Clinics are used to you. Shame is a public-health enemy.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Puberty is a hormonal timetable with variance
domains.summary: Puberty is a hormonal timetable with variance. Early, late, uneven. All of it can be normal and still need a GP if it is distressing or very skewed. Sweat, skin, mood — a cluster.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A backpack is a physics problem
domains.summary: A backpack is a physics problem. Two straps, close to the back, not 20 kg of ‘just in case’. Screens at eye height save a neck. Pain that wakes you is a tell-someone.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Heat is a medical emergency waiting in November
domains.summary: Heat is a medical emergency waiting in November. Cramps → exhaustion → stroke as a crude ladder. Stop, shade, cool, 000 if confused or hot and dry/odd. Sport postponement is a.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Cold steals judgement first
domains.summary: Cold steals judgement first. Hypothermia is a quiet slide. Wet cotton is a liar. Wind. Get dry, insulated, calories, 000 if they stop shivering and get confused.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: An asthma action plan is a document, not a rumour
domains.summary: An asthma action plan is a document, not a rumour. Reliever vs preventer. 4×4×4 is a protocol you should only use as currently taught. If the puffer is empty, that is a planning.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Diabetes is insulin and glucose, not ‘too much sugar personality’
domains.summary: Diabetes is insulin and glucose, not ‘too much sugar personality’. Type 1 is autoimmune; Type 2 is a different pattern (still not a slur). Hypos are a timer: juice as per their.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Blood is a supply chain of humans
domains.summary: Blood is a supply chain of humans. Types, iron, age/weight rules. You cannot donate your way out of a test. Needles are a clinic skill, not a dare.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Do not put the cotton bud further in
domains.summary: Do not put the cotton bud further in. Ears are self-cleaning-ish. Buds pack wax. Perforated drums are a GP file. Noise damage is forever hair cells.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A study setup is a body for hours
domains.summary: A study setup is a body for hours. Screen, chair, breaks (20-20-20 for eyes). Pain is a signal. Standing desks are not holiness if you still hunch.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A team has jobs besides scorer
domains.summary: A team has jobs besides scorer. Communicator, encourager, equipment, first-aid watcher. PE is social and physical. Bench-warming as humiliation is bad coaching.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Modified games are still games
domains.summary: Modified games are still games. Change the ball, the zone, the numbers. Disability is not ‘sit out and hold a stopwatch’ by default. Ask the person.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: A bushwalk is a plan with a time
domains.summary: A bushwalk is a plan with a time. Tell someone, map, water, weather, turn-back time. A phone dead in a gully is a paperweight. National parks still eat the cocky.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: After a session, you are a repair job
domains.summary: After a session, you are a repair job. Protein plus carbs in a normal meal beats a $9 powder for most school sport. Chocolate milk is a meme with some evidence and also a sugar.

domains.subject: health
domains.title: Periods are health data, not a punchline
domains.summary: Periods are health data, not a punchline. Pain, iron, and sport. Missing many in a row with heavy sport can be RED-S territory — a GP, not a coach’s shrug. Products in bathrooms.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A beat is a pulse you can agree on
domains.summary: A beat is a pulse you can agree on. Steady pulse vs rhythm (the pattern on top). Clap the pulse, then the rhythm. If they collapse into one, the groove is mush.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Tempo is a speed with a name
domains.summary: Tempo is a speed with a name. BPM, allegro vs andante. A metronome is a truth-teller. ‘Feeling it’ can still drag.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Metre is how beats are grouped
domains.summary: Metre is how beats are grouped. 4/4, 3/4, 6/8 feel different in the body. The time signature is a claim about the pulse grouping, not a font.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Syncopation accents the off
domains.summary: Syncopation accents the off. Stress where you did not expect. Jazz, funk, a lot of pop. If you cannot tap the silent pulse, you cannot place the off-beat.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A rest is a note with a volume of zero
domains.summary: A rest is a note with a volume of zero. Counted, not skipped. The hole is the music. Beginners eat rests like they are optional garnish.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Two pulses stacked is a negotiation
domains.summary: Two pulses stacked is a negotiation. 3 against 2 is the gateway. Each hand has a job. Slow, then glue.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A phrase is a musical sentence
domains.summary: A phrase is a musical sentence. Breathe where the sentence ends, not every bar because you panic. Four-bar default is a habit, not a law.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Groove is placement, not just volume
domains.summary: Groove is placement, not just volume. Ahead, on, behind the beat — tiny. A click and a recording will humble you. Quantise in a DAW can kill the human if you max it.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Pitch is a frequency we name
domains.summary: Pitch is a frequency we name. A4 ≈ 440 Hz in many rooms (not a moral law). Higher Hz, higher pitch. An octave is a doubling.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: An octave is the same letter, a different height
domains.summary: An octave is the same letter, a different height. C to C. Harmonic series neighbourhood. Men and women (and kids) can sing ‘the same note’ an octave apart and be right.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A major scale is a pattern of steps
domains.summary: A major scale is a pattern of steps. WWHWWWH. Move the pattern, change the key. It is not ‘the happy scale’ as a law — context and speed argue.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Minor is a family, not one scale
domains.summary: Minor is a family, not one scale. Natural, harmonic (raised 7), melodic (up/down habits). The raised 7 is why a ‘sad’ piece can still have a leading note bite.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: An interval is a distance with a name
domains.summary: An interval is a distance with a name. 2nds, 3rds, tritones. Quality (major/minor/perfect). Ear training is reps, not a gift only some babies get.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A triad is 1-3-5 of a world
domains.summary: A triad is 1-3-5 of a world. Major/minor/diminished/augmented. Inversions put a different member in the basement. The bass note is a character.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A cadence is a comma or a full stop
domains.summary: A cadence is a comma or a full stop. V–I authentic, IV–I plagal (‘amen’), authentic vs deceptive. The ear knows even if the worksheet is late.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Modulation is a house move
domains.summary: Modulation is a house move. Pivot chord, or just land with a drum fill in pop. The ear needs a reason or it is a lurch.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A melody is a shape before it is a row of dots
domains.summary: A melody is a shape before it is a row of dots. Steps vs leaps, a peak, a return. Too many leaps is a goat on a roof. Too many steps can be a mutter.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Harmony is why a chord feels like home or a trip
domains.summary: Harmony is why a chord feels like home or a trip. Tonic, dominant, subdominant as jobs. A ii–V–I is a sentence in jazz. Roman numerals travel across keys.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Timbre is why a trumpet is not a flute on the same pitch
domains.summary: Timbre is why a trumpet is not a flute on the same pitch. Overtones, attack, mute, distortion. EQ is timbre surgery. ‘Tone’ in guitar ads is this word in a leather jacket.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Dynamics are designed contrast
domains.summary: Dynamics are designed contrast. p to f, crescendo as a line, not a switch at the last second. A piece that is mf forever is a grey wall.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Texture is how many stories at once
domains.summary: Texture is how many stories at once. Monophony, homophony, polyphony. A pop vocal plus pads is often melody-and-accompaniment. A round is polyphony with a smile.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: An envelope is attack-decay-sustain-release
domains.summary: An envelope is attack-decay-sustain-release. A piano is a different envelope from an organ. Sidechain compression is a dance-floor envelope joke.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: EQ is volume per neighbourhood of frequency
domains.summary: EQ is volume per neighbourhood of frequency. Cut mud (low-mids) before you boost sparkle as a reflex. A smile EQ on everything is a hiss and a thump fighting.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Compression is automatic volume riding
domains.summary: Compression is automatic volume riding. Threshold, ratio, attack. Too much and the song is a brick (loud but small). It is not ‘making it better’ as a religion.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Reverb is a room you fake
domains.summary: Reverb is a room you fake. Decay, pre-delay, wet/dry. A huge hall on a rap vocal can bury words. Rooms tell genre stories.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Balance is a social skill
domains.summary: Balance is a social skill. If you cannot hear the smallest voice, you are too loud. Blend is matching vowels and tone, not disappearing as a moral.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Tuning is a moving target in a group
domains.summary: Tuning is a moving target in a group. Reference pitch, then fifths that want to be sweet, then equal temperament pianos that will not budge. Pick a boss (oboe, keyboard) and obey.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A rehearsal is surgery, not a full performance every time
domains.summary: A rehearsal is surgery, not a full performance every time. Start at bar 47, the ugly one. Run-throughs late. Talking is the enemy unless it is a specific instruction.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: An inner part is not a failed melody
domains.summary: An inner part is not a failed melody. Harmony jobs, groove jobs, a bass that is a spine. If you ‘fix’ it by playing the tune, the texture collapses.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A beat pattern is information
domains.summary: A beat pattern is information. Ictus, prep beat, cut-off. If you watch, entries improve. If you bury your head, you are a soloist in a crowd.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Form is a map you can hear
domains.summary: Form is a map you can hear. Binary, ternary, verse-chorus, 12-bar, sonata as a later mountain. A repeat sign is a time machine.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A motif is a small idea that gets a job
domains.summary: A motif is a small idea that gets a job. Beethoven’s da-da-da-dum is the cliché because it is true. Development is the idea in a new hat.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A genre is a contract of expectations
domains.summary: A genre is a contract of expectations. Drum pattern, harmony diet, vocal timbre. Crossing it is interesting if you know what you crossed.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A tradition is a people, not a plugin
domains.summary: A tradition is a people, not a plugin. Didgeridoo, gamelan, mbira — names, jobs, permission. Sampling without care is a theft with a DAW.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Australian music is more than a pub chorus
domains.summary: Australian music is more than a pub chorus. First Nations song, colonial brass, pub rock, electronic scenes, diaspora pop. A single ‘Australian sound’ is a marketing sentence.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A score is a map, not the terrain
domains.summary: A score is a map, not the terrain. You still have to hear. Follow a line with a finger. Repeat marks, DS al coda — the geography of paper.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Improvisation is limits plus ears
domains.summary: Improvisation is limits plus ears. A scale, a rhythm cell, a call-and-response. Infinite notes is noise. Jazz language is vocabulary, not ‘random high notes’.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A hook is memorable under constraint
domains.summary: A hook is memorable under constraint. Short, repeatable, a twist on bar 2. If you cannot hum it, it is not a hook yet. Lyrics can be the hook. A rhythm can.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Lyrics need the stress on the right syllable
domains.summary: Lyrics need the stress on the right syllable. If you put ‘um-BRELL-a’ on the wrong beat it will fight the groove. Speak it, then place it.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Beaming is how the eye finds the beat
domains.summary: Beaming is how the eye finds the beat. Group notes so the pulse is visible. A soup of unbeamed quavers is a trap. Ties vs dots — pick the readable one.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Practice is a loop: slow, right, then faster
domains.summary: Practice is a loop: slow, right, then faster. A mistake at full speed is you practising the mistake. Hands separate, then together. 10 focused minutes beat 40 fogs.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Performance is a different skill from the bedroom
domains.summary: Performance is a different skill from the bedroom. Nerves, bow, the first note as a decision. A stumble is not a funeral — keep the pulse. Talk to the audience like they are.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A song is property, even if TikTok is loud
domains.summary: A song is property, even if TikTok is loud. Melody and recording are different rights. School covers have rules. Sampling is not a personality.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Red clipping is a brick wall
domains.summary: Red clipping is a brick wall. Gain staging: leave headroom. 0 dBFS is not a target for every clip. Loudness is a master-bus conversation later.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: MIDI is instructions; audio is the air
domains.summary: MIDI is instructions; audio is the air. A MIDI violin is a puppet. Audio is a recording of a violin. Quantise MIDI; be careful quantising a human take to death.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A microphone is a point of view
domains.summary: A microphone is a point of view. Distance, axis, and the room. Proximity effect on a cardioid bass-boosts. A phone mic is a mic with an opinion.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Hearing is not a renewable resource
domains.summary: Hearing is not a renewable resource. SPL and time. Musicians get tinnitus as an occupational souvenir. Plugs are a technique.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Baroque likes a motor and a fancy bass
domains.summary: Baroque likes a motor and a fancy bass. Continuo, ornament, dance metres, Bach vs a court job. Terraced dynamics. It is not ‘all wigs’.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Classical (the era) likes a clear sentence
domains.summary: Classical (the era) likes a clear sentence. Haydn, Mozart, early Beethoven. Periodic phrases, a development that actually develops. Not ‘any orchestral music’.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Romantic (the era) turns the tap
domains.summary: Romantic (the era) turns the tap. Bigger orchestra, extra feeling as a brand, national stories, a pianist-hero. Rubato with a spine, not soup.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: The 20th century broke the contract on purpose
domains.summary: The 20th century broke the contract on purpose. Atonality, serialism, minimalism, jazz, tape, punk. Many 20ths. A classroom that only does Schoenberg is a thin 20th.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A 12-bar is a neighbourhood
domains.summary: A 12-bar is a neighbourhood. I–IV–V with a language of blue notes. Swing vs straight. It is African American history, not a smoky font.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A pop record is a sculpture of attention
domains.summary: A pop record is a sculpture of attention. Intro in 5 seconds, chorus as a reward, loudness, a featured artist as a market. The songwriter and the performer can be a crowd.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Diegetic vs underscoring is a camera’s ear
domains.summary: Diegetic vs underscoring is a camera’s ear. Is the band in the room? Mickey-mousing vs a theme that knows more than the character. Silence is a cue.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Game music is a state machine
domains.summary: Game music is a state machine. Loops, layers that enter in combat, a stinger on death. Adaptive vs linear. Memory is a ROM limit historically.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A voice has a range and a texture
domains.summary: A voice has a range and a texture. Soprano to bass as a map, not a personality test. Passaggio is a gear change. Choirs blend on purpose.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Transcription is listening with a pencil
domains.summary: Transcription is listening with a pencil. Short, slow, one line. Rhythm first or pitch first — pick a method. It is a muscle.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: A critique is evidence plus a because
domains.summary: A critique is evidence plus a because. ‘I liked it’ is a start. ‘The snare is late to the kick in verse two, which loosens the funk’ is a critique.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Silence is a written event
domains.summary: Silence is a written event. A rest, a bar of nothing, a hall that holds its breath. John Cage made a joke that is also a listening lesson. Beginners fill every hole because.

domains.subject: music
domains.title: Music is a passport and a fence
domains.summary: Music is a passport and a fence. Subcultures, scenes, who is allowed on a stage. Appropriation vs exchange is a live argument. Your playlist is a map of class and city too.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A line has a job: edge, rhythm, or whisper
domains.summary: A line has a job: edge, rhythm, or whisper. Weight, speed, and interrupted vs continuous. A contour can search (blind contour) or declare. Sketch lines are not a failure of the.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Negative space is a shape, not leftover air
domains.summary: Negative space is a shape, not leftover air. Draw the hole and the object arrives. A bad drawing often lies in the gaps. Notan is a dark/light shape thinking.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Value does more than hue in a lot of pictures
domains.summary: Value does more than hue in a lot of pictures. Lights and darks make form. Squint to kill detail. A greyscale pass saves a muddy painting.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Edges are hard, soft, lost
domains.summary: Edges are hard, soft, lost. A lost edge lets the eye complete. Everything razor-sharp is a sticker sheet. Focus is a hierarchy.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: One-point is a hallway contract
domains.summary: One-point is a hallway contract. A vanishing point on the horizon. Orthogonal lines obey. People cheat the furniture and the room screams.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Two-point is a corner of a building
domains.summary: Two-point is a corner of a building. Two VPs on the horizon. Verticals stay vertical in the basic room (until you tilt the camera). A third point is a worm/bird drama.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A face is a stack of measurements, then a person
domains.summary: A face is a stack of measurements, then a person. Eyes halfway (adult), spacing, ear aligned with features. Caricature is a measured lie. Beginners plant features on the forehead.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Gesture is the action line, not the costume wrinkles first
domains.summary: Gesture is the action line, not the costume wrinkles first. 30-second poses. The spine’s curve, the weight on a foot. A stiff mannequin is a drawing that skipped this.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A wheel is a map, not a moral
domains.summary: A wheel is a map, not a moral. Primaries depend on the system (paint vs light). Complementary clash and vibrate. Mud is often a complement mix you did not admit.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Temperature is a relative push-pull
domains.summary: Temperature is a relative push-pull. A warm red vs a cool red. Distance often cools in aerial perspective. A ‘warm’ painting can still have cool shadows that make the lights glow.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Saturation is how loud the hue is
domains.summary: Saturation is how loud the hue is. Greys and browns are colours with the volume down. If every pixel is max sat, nothing is loud. A focal sat is a spotlight.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A limited palette is a choir with few singers
domains.summary: A limited palette is a choir with few singers. Zorn-ish or earths plus one loud. Harmony is easier when you cannot grab 24 tubes as a panic.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Form lives in planes of light
domains.summary: Form lives in planes of light. A sphere: highlight, mid, terminator, reflected, cast. A face is planes, not a blending fetish. The terminator is a place, not a smudge accident.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A cast shadow is a shape with a job
domains.summary: A cast shadow is a shape with a job. It anchors the object to a ground. Soft vs hard tells you the light size. A floating object often forgot the cast.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Rule of thirds is a habit, not a police
domains.summary: Rule of thirds is a habit, not a police. Interest off-centre. Horizon not in the middle unless you mean a mirror. Breaking it is allowed when you know you broke it.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Hierarchy is what you see first, second, last
domains.summary: Hierarchy is what you see first, second, last. Scale, contrast, placement, isolation. A poster with five ‘most important’ things has zero. Type size is a shout.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A grid is a set of decisions that repeat
domains.summary: A grid is a set of decisions that repeat. Columns, margins, a baseline. Breaking the grid is a drum fill — you need the beat first. Alignment is a quiet professionalism.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Letters have anatomy, not just fonts with personalities
domains.summary: Letters have anatomy, not just fonts with personalities. X-height, descenders, kerning vs tracking. A display face at 6pt is cruelty. Body text is a reading tool.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Contrast and length of line decide if it gets read
domains.summary: Contrast and length of line decide if it gets read. Grey on grey, 80-character lines, and centred body paragraphs are how you hide text in plain sight. WCAG is not only a web.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A logo is a tool in sizes, not a novel
domains.summary: A logo is a tool in sizes, not a novel. Works in one colour, at a favicon, without 12 gradients. The idea should survive a stamp. A brief beats a vibe.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A poster has a viewing distance
domains.summary: A poster has a viewing distance. Headline, image, a necessary fact (time/place). If you need a QR and a novel, you needed a flyer. Alignment and one accent colour can be enough.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A photograph is a crop of time and a rectangle
domains.summary: A photograph is a crop of time and a rectangle. Frame, moment, and the edge of the frame (what you cut). Burst + pick is allowed. ‘I will crop in post’ can be a sloppy eye —.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Exposure is a three-way deal
domains.summary: Exposure is a three-way deal. Aperture, shutter, ISO. A blown highlight is gone in a JPEG. ETTR is a nerd tool; blown skies are a beginner tell.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Balance can be a scale or a tightrope
domains.summary: Balance can be a scale or a tightrope. Symmetry is calm (or boring, or power). Asymmetry needs a counterweight (a small dark vs a large light). A page that slides off one side is.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Visual rhythm is repeat plus variation
domains.summary: Visual rhythm is repeat plus variation. A pattern that never varies is wallpaper (fine if you mean wallpaper). A repeat with a glitch is a beat. Comics use panel rhythm.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: The material is a collaborator, not a slave
domains.summary: The material is a collaborator, not a slave. Watercolour blooms, lino fights small details, clay remembers fingerprints. Fighting a medium 100% is a look; listening is another.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A finished piece is often number 8 wearing number 1’s idea
domains.summary: A finished piece is often number 8 wearing number 1’s idea. Thumbnails, a reject pile, a redo of the face. Precious first lines are a trap. Process pages are evidence of.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Talk about what the work does, not the person’s soul
domains.summary: Talk about what the work does, not the person’s soul. ‘The left edge is busy so the face loses’ beats ‘you are bad at faces’. Ask what they meant. Then whether the picture keeps.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A sketchbook is a lab, not a gallery
domains.summary: A sketchbook is a lab, not a gallery. Ugly pages, notes, tickets, a bad idea that becomes a good one in three weeks. Performing a ‘perfect sketchbook’ for marks can kill the lab.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A studio is a workshop with lungs
domains.summary: A studio is a workshop with lungs. Solvents, clay silica, a lino cutter toward the other hand, a heat gun. Ventilation is not a vibe. Food and ink do not share a table.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A print is an edition with a logic
domains.summary: A print is an edition with a logic. The matrix, the reverse (in many processes), a registration. A ghost print is a leftover, sometimes beautiful. Numbering 1/10 is a claim — do.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: An armature is a skeleton so the clay can be flesh
domains.summary: An armature is a skeleton so the clay can be flesh. Wire, a join that will not snap, weight at the base. Hollow thick clay or it explodes in a kiln — ceramics has its own physics.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Layers are an undo philosophy
domains.summary: Layers are an undo philosophy. Name them, group, a flatten at the end if you must. Adjustment layers vs cooking the pixels. Resolution (300dpi print vs 72 screen) is a decision.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Vectors are maths; rasters are a grid
domains.summary: Vectors are maths; rasters are a grid. Logos want vectors. Photos are rasters. A ‘vector look’ on a photo is a filter, not a true vector of the person.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A work sits in a time and a power
domains.summary: A work sits in a time and a power. Who paid, who is shown, who was allowed in the academy. A nude is not only ‘skill with anatomy’ — it is a gaze with a history. Provenance is a.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Taking an image is a conversation or a theft
domains.summary: Taking an image is a conversation or a theft. Pop art made a method. First Nations designs have protocols, not a vibe of ‘inspiration’. School: cite, transform with a reason, do.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Living cultures, living rules
domains.summary: Living cultures, living rules. Dot painting is not a free texture pack. Some stories are not for you. Consult, commission, do not photocopy a desert for a term poster without a.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: The gum is a loaded tree
domains.summary: The gum is a loaded tree. Heidelberg, desert painters, and a tourist tea-towel. Light in Australia is a technical problem (harsh) and a myth. Who is in the landscape — and who is.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Modernism was a pile of arguments, not one ugly font
domains.summary: Modernism was a pile of arguments, not one ugly font. Cubism, abstraction, ‘make it new’, a break with academy stories. It was also Paris with money and colonies in the.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Contemporary is the argument happening now
domains.summary: Contemporary is the argument happening now. Installation, time-based, social practice, a biennale. Skill can be outsourced and still be a work — the idea is not automatically.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A pretty thing can still be a harm
domains.summary: A pretty thing can still be a harm. Dark patterns, cigarette ads of the past, a stereotype that sells. You can refuse a brief. School: you can change a poster that punches down.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Colour is not the only channel
domains.summary: Colour is not the only channel. Do not encode ‘bad’ as red-only. Patterns, text, position. Simulators exist. A beautiful dashboard that 8% of men fail is a broken dashboard.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: An icon is a silhouette at 24px
domains.summary: An icon is a silhouette at 24px. One idea, few strokes, a consistent set (same stroke, same corner). A detailed cathedral as a 16px favicon is a blur.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A storyboard is time as rectangles
domains.summary: A storyboard is time as rectangles. Shots, a camera move, what the audience knows. Arrows are not optional if the camera moves. A comic is a cousin.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Comics are time, closure, and a gutter
domains.summary: Comics are time, closure, and a gutter. McCloud’s closure: the reader fills the gap. A splash is a shout. Lettering is drawing.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A brand is a system, not a logo file
domains.summary: A brand is a system, not a logo file. Type, colour, a photo style, a ‘we never do this’. A PDF of rules is a kindness to future-you. Inconsistency is a look — usually accidental.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A portfolio is a curated argument
domains.summary: A portfolio is a curated argument. Best work, a process page, a caption that is not a novel. Kill the piece you love that does not fit the brief you are applying to.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A master copy is a conversation, not a forgery for sale
domains.summary: A master copy is a conversation, not a forgery for sale. You learn their decisions. Label it ‘study after’. Do not enter it as your original. Then do a piece that answers them.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A sculpture in a plaza has weather and vandals and a crowd
domains.summary: A sculpture in a plaza has weather and vandals and a crowd. Scale, site lines, who sits on it. A memorial is a brief with grief in it. Maintenance is part of the design.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Craft is design with a material intelligence
domains.summary: Craft is design with a material intelligence. A joint in wood, a stitch, a glaze fit. ‘Just craft’ as an insult is a class story. Function can be the idea.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A collage is a collision with authorship issues
domains.summary: A collage is a collision with authorship issues. Cut, layer, a new sentence from old images. Copyright still exists. Magazines are not a free quarry for a commercial poster.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Installation is a room as a medium
domains.summary: Installation is a room as a medium. Walk path, smell, sound, a duration. A maquette (model) saves a disaster. OH&S is the unsexy medium.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Print colour is a different physics from the screen
domains.summary: Print colour is a different physics from the screen. RGB glow vs CMYK ink. A neon on screen can die on paper. Soft-proof, then a real proof if it matters.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A near-symmetry with one break is a spotlight
domains.summary: A near-symmetry with one break is a spotlight. The eye goes to the rebel element. Too many rebels and it is noise. A face with one earring in a portrait is this.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Human scale is a body in the picture
domains.summary: Human scale is a body in the picture. A door, a figure, a coin. Without a scale cue, a sculpture photo is a toy or a monument — you cannot tell. Architecture drawings put a stick.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Implied motion is a still that leaks time
domains.summary: Implied motion is a still that leaks time. Blur, a repeated position, a diagonal, a comic speed line. A frozen dancer can still move if the gesture is mid-arc.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Abstraction is a reduction with a remaining pulse
domains.summary: Abstraction is a reduction with a remaining pulse. From a still life, remove until a rhythm of shapes. If nothing of the looking remains, you may have a design — that can be OK.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A thumbnail is a value test the size of a stamp
domains.summary: A thumbnail is a value test the size of a stamp. If the composition fails at 2 cm, a metre of detail will not save it. Graphic designers know this; painters forget it. Blur your.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: Site-specific means the place is a material
domains.summary: Site-specific means the place is a material. Light at 4pm, a wind, a crowd path, a stain on the wall. Move it to a white cube and it can die. A proposal has to visit the site,.

domains.subject: art
domains.title: A show order is an argument
domains.summary: A show order is an argument. What is next to what. A wall colour. A label’s first sentence. Student folios are tiny curations.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The rule of law is nobody above the same basic rules
domains.summary: The rule of law is nobody above the same basic rules. Government, police, you. Exceptions (immunity, kids) are defined, not vibes. A ‘the king can do no wrong’ leftover is a.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A rule needs a harm it is trying to catch
domains.summary: A rule needs a harm it is trying to catch. Speed limits are kinetic energy. Phone bans in class are attention. A rule with no harm is a habit or a control.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A consequence should fit and be known in advance
domains.summary: A consequence should fit and be known in advance. Natural, logical, legal. Surprise punishments train fear, not a principle. Restorative is a different tool, not a synonym for.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A right is a claim with a rim
domains.summary: A right is a claim with a rim. Speech, safety, reputation. Your shout ends near someone else’s nose (and their dignity, and a court’s test). Kids’ rights are real and not.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Procedure is a civic technology
domains.summary: Procedure is a civic technology. Hear both, evidence, an appeal. A pile-on is not a tribunal. Natural justice is an old name for this.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The Constitution is a hard-to-edit rulebook
domains.summary: The Constitution is a hard-to-edit rulebook. Federal split, a High Court as umpire, referendums (s 128) that usually fail. It is not a novel of values — much of that is.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Federalism is two (plus) governments in one country
