domains.summary: Federalism is two (plus) governments in one country. Commonwealth, states/territories, local. Overlap is the mess (health, education). Blame-shifting is a sport.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Parliament is a law factory with a theatre attached
domains.summary: Parliament is a law factory with a theatre attached. House of Reps (government usually), Senate (states, a brake), a bill’s stages. Question Time is theatre; committees can be.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Parties are teams with tickets
domains.summary: Parties are teams with tickets. Discipline, factions, how-to-vote cards. Independents still have to count. A party is not a family; it is a career structure too.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Enrol, rank, a Saturday
domains.summary: Enrol, rank, a Saturday. Preferential voting in the House, PR in the Senate (more or less). Compulsory enrolment/voting is a design — turnout is high, informal is a thing. AEC is.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Preferences are a second (and third) life of a vote
domains.summary: Preferences are a second (and third) life of a vote. If your first is last, your next number can still decide. How-to-vote cards are advice, not law. Exhaustion in some systems.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The Senate was a states’ house that became a party house too
domains.summary: The Senate was a states’ house that became a party house too. Equal senators per original state. Proportional-ish. A government can lack a Senate majority — that is a feature.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The High Court is not a third house of parliament
domains.summary: The High Court is not a third house of parliament. Constitutional umpire, appeals. Judges are not elected. Appointments are political in the real world and legal in the job.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The Governor-General is a reserve-power fire extinguisher
domains.summary: The Governor-General is a reserve-power fire extinguisher. Assent, a ceremonial load, and 1975 as the argument that never cooled. Convention is the unwritten operating system.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Councils are closest and ignored
domains.summary: Councils are closest and ignored. Bins, libraries, planning. Rates. A DA (development application) is local politics with a clipboard. Turnout at council polls can be sleepy and.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Responsible government means the executive sits in parliament
domains.summary: Responsible government means the executive sits in parliament. Ministers from the parliament, confidence, a PM who can be dumped by their party without a general election. Not a.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A referendum is a double majority lock
domains.summary: A referendum is a double majority lock. National majority plus a majority of states. That is why most fail. The question’s wording is a battlefield.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A budget is a moral document in numbers
domains.summary: A budget is a moral document in numbers. What we tax, what we buy (defence, Medicare, schools). A surplus is not automatically virtue. Debt can be a tool. Bracket creep is a.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Australia has rights, not one US-style bill as the whole story
domains.summary: Australia has rights, not one US-style bill as the whole story. Implied political communication, statutes (discrimination, privacy), common law, international treaties that do.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: UDHR is a global script, not a magic wand
domains.summary: UDHR is a global script, not a magic wand. 1948, a list, a politics of who drafted. It does not auto-strike an Australian statute. Advocacy uses it as a language.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Discrimination law is a set of protected attributes and tests
domains.summary: Discrimination law is a set of protected attributes and tests. Race, sex, disability, age, more. A ‘I was rude to everyone’ is a different (bad) thing. Exemptions exist and are.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Protest is speech plus a place plus a time
domains.summary: Protest is speech plus a place plus a time. Permits, move-on, a line between assembly and a riot. Police powers are a statute pile. Civil disobedience is a choice with a bill.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A press is a watchdog with a business model
domains.summary: A press is a watchdog with a business model. Investigation, a deadline, a proprietor. Public broadcasting (ABC/SBS) is a different charter. A collapse of local news is a civic.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Defamation is a rich person’s sport with a public-interest defence that is work
domains.summary: Defamation is a rich person’s sport with a public-interest defence that is work. Truth, honest opinion, a publication. Sharing a lie is publishing. Australia is not the US on.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Lobbying is organised asking
domains.summary: Lobbying is organised asking. Access, donations, a revolving door. Not automatically corrupt; not automatically speech in a pure sense. Registers exist because of the smell.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A union is a legal technology for bargaining
domains.summary: A union is a legal technology for bargaining. Collective vs one scared person. Strikes have rules. You can disagree with a union and still understand the tool. Non-union is also.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A jury is a randomly unlucky education
domains.summary: A jury is a randomly unlucky education. Facts vs law (judge). Unanimity or majority depending. Empanelling is a filter. It is not 12 Angry Men as a documentary.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Police are a state monopoly on legitimate force — with a law around it
domains.summary: Police are a state monopoly on legitimate force — with a law around it. Powers to stop, search, arrest — statute and a reason. A complaint body. ‘Just following orders’ is a thin.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Appeals go up; most justice is down in the busy courts
domains.summary: Appeals go up; most justice is down in the busy courts. Magistrates, District/County, Supreme, High. Most people meet traffic and small claims, not a constitutional drama.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: NGOs are private organisations with a public pitch
domains.summary: NGOs are private organisations with a public pitch. Aid, advocacy, a fundraising machine. Accountability is a live issue (who elected them?). They can be a voice for people with.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The UN is a club of states, not a world government
domains.summary: The UN is a club of states, not a world government. General Assembly theatre, Security Council vetoes, agencies that actually vaccinate. Paralysis is a design of 1945 great-power.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Sovereignty is a claim to be the boss inside a border
domains.summary: Sovereignty is a claim to be the boss inside a border. Westphalian sticker, then the holes (treaties, markets, climate, corporations). First Nations sovereignty is a different,.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: IHL is a rulebook for a thing that is already a failure
domains.summary: IHL is a rulebook for a thing that is already a failure. Distinction, proportionality, civilians. War crimes are a category. Having a law of war is not a blessing of war.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A refugee is a legal category, not a mood
domains.summary: A refugee is a legal category, not a mood. Persecution, a border, UNHCR, a domestic statute. Asylum is a process. Deterrence is a policy with a body count and a politics.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Foreign aid is a budget line with a strategy

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A trade agreement is a law about stuff crossing borders
domains.summary: A trade agreement is a law about stuff crossing borders. Tariffs, ISDS fights, labour and environment chapters that can be toothless. Cheaper goods, smashed towns — both can be.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A feed is not a country
domains.summary: A feed is not a country. Diaspora news, a state broadcaster, a platform algorithm. Foreign influence is a real file and a moral panic, sometimes both.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Disinformation is a designed false, not a oops
domains.summary: Disinformation is a designed false, not a oops. A lie with a strategy. Misinfo can be a share without a plot. Deepfakes are a later accelerant. The civic skill is slow sharing.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A state database is a power
domains.summary: A state database is a power. Tax file, health, a camera on a street. Mission creep is the civic disease. Oversight is boring and necessary.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A citizenship is a legal status with a door
domains.summary: A citizenship is a legal status with a door. Birth, descent, conferral. Dual is a politics (s 44 was a circus). Statelessness is a hole. A passport is a document, not a.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: First Nations politics is not a sidebar
domains.summary: First Nations politics is not a sidebar. Sovereignty claims, native title, Closing the Gap as a report card, a Voice debate that was a referendum. Treaties in some states. This.

domains.summary: Age is a civic on/off in layers. Vote at 18, drive earlier, a criminal age, a social media age fight. ‘Nothing about us without us’ still hits kids last. Youth parliaments are.

domains.subject: civics

domains.summary: A consumer is a civic role in a market. ACL, a regulator (ACCC), a lemon law neighbourhood. Your small print is a power imbalance the law tries to tilt.

domains.summary: An EPBC-style law is a delay and a deal. Federal environment powers, a state EPA, a court case that is a habitat. Climate is a civic file, not only a science one — because of who.

domains.summary: Corruption is private gain from public office — and a grey fog around it. A brown paper bag, a mate’s contract, a job for a spouse. Integrity commissions exist because of the.

domains.summary: Cabinet is a collective secret, until it leaks. Solidarity, a minute, a leak to a journalist as a weapon. The public service is supposed to be professional, not a colour.

domains.summary: A poll is a snapshot with a method. Sample, a house effect, a leading question. A 3% swing in a small poll is a maybe. Betting markets are not oracles.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: Civic habits are inherited and invented
domains.summary: Civic habits are inherited and invented. Federation deals, a secret ballot as an export, a White Australia we had to unlearn. A tradition can be a resource or a cage.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A global citizen is a metaphor with a passport still in the drawer
domains.summary: A global citizen is a metaphor with a passport still in the drawer. Climate, a pandemic, a supply chain. Duties beyond the border are argued (aid, refugees, emissions). The.

domains.summary: A student council is a pedagogy, not a parliament. Low stakes, a budget of sausages, a lesson in agendas. Tokenism is when the decision was made in the office. A good one has a.

domains.summary: A platform is a private square with public effects. Moderation is a policy, not a court. Deplatforming is a company choice. The civic ask is whether speech rules should be.

domains.summary: Hansard is the tape of the factory. Who said what, a correction, a point of order. It is boring on purpose. A clip without the Hansard line is a trailer.

domains.summary: Freedom of information is a request, not a dump. Exemptions, a delay, a $ fee in some places. Cabinet, national security, a commercial-in-confidence. A journalist’s job and a.

domains.summary: An ombudsman is a complaint shop with a limited menu. Maladministration, not a re-run of a policy you dislike. Fair, a report, sometimes no teeth but a light. Know which ombuds.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A royal commission is a spotlight with a counsel assisting
domains.summary: A royal commission is a spotlight with a counsel assisting. Terms of reference, a witness, a report that can sit on a shelf. It is not a court of guilt in the usual way..

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: The Reserve Bank is a rate-setter with a board
domains.summary: The Reserve Bank is a rate-setter with a board. Independence as a design, inflation vs jobs as a trade-off story, a statement day. It is not a piggy bank for a PM’s weekend..

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A mandatory sentence is a parliament tying a judge’s hands
domains.summary: A mandatory sentence is a parliament tying a judge’s hands. Deterrence as a theory, a young person in a number, a judicial discretion fight. Evidence on deterrence is a live.

domains.summary: Two houses are a delay with a purpose. A bill that dies in the Senate is a result, not a glitch, if that is the design. Unicameral Qld is a contrast. A stacked upper house is a.

domains.subject: civics
domains.title: A civic virtue is a habit, not a hashtag
domains.summary: A civic virtue is a habit, not a hashtag. Jury duty, a truth in a form, a queue, a vote you researched for 20 minutes. You can hate a government and still not cheat a census..

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: A language is a system, not a secret code you decrypt once
domains.summary: A language is a system, not a secret code you decrypt once. Sounds, words, grammar, use. You cannot ‘download’ it in a weekend. A phrasebook is a map of a few streets, not the.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: The sound-to-meaning link is mostly a social deal
domains.summary: The sound-to-meaning link is mostly a social deal. Dog, chien, 犬. Onomatopoeia is the exception people over-love. A rose by any other name is the point.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: Small sounds combine into many words
domains.summary: Small sounds combine into many words. Phonemes are not meaning; morphemes start to be. That is why a handful of sounds can name a universe. Productivity is a feature.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: You can talk about not-here, not-now
domains.summary: You can talk about not-here, not-now. Yesterday, a myth, a plan. Bees dance a displacement of a kind; humans go wild with it. Lying is a dark twin of displacement.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: A creole is a full language with a rushed childhood
domains.summary: A creole is a full language with a rushed childhood. Pidgin in a contact mess, then kids nativise it. It is not ‘broken’ English. Haitian Creole is a language. Respect the grammar.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: A dialect is a system, not a mistake pile
domains.summary: A dialect is a system, not a mistake pile. Every speaker has a variety. ‘Standard’ is a dialect with a school and a job market. AAPMB (African American English) has rules. So.

domains.summary: Meaning is more than the dictionary line. ‘Can you pass the salt?’ is a request, not a strength test. Implicature. A literal robot fails dinner.

domains.summary: Some sentences do a thing. I promise, I name this ship, I apologise. Conditions can fail (you cannot marry people without a licence). Austin/Searle neighbourhood.

domains.title: A phoneme is a difference that makes a word difference
domains.summary: A phoneme is a difference that makes a word difference. Minimal pairs: ship/sheep, bit/pit. Your language trains you to hear some and miss others. /l/ vs /r/ is a famous training.

domains.summary: IPA is a map of mouths. One symbol, a sound, in principle. English spelling is not a map. Schwa is the star of unstressed English.

domains.title: Words bleed in fast speech
domains.summary: Words bleed in fast speech. Gonna, linking r, a dropped t. Learners who only know the page will not hear the street. Slow is a skill; fast is a different skill.

domains.title: An alphabet is (roughly) phoneme-to-letter, with a lie rate
domains.summary: An alphabet is (roughly) phoneme-to-letter, with a lie rate. English’s lie rate is high (ough). Finnish’s is low. A spelling reform is a political bomb.

domains.subject: languages
domains.title: An abjad leans on consonants; vowels can be optional marks
domains.summary: An abjad leans on consonants; vowels can be optional marks. Arabic, Hebrew as typical stories. Context and a reader’s brain fill vowels. A Qur’an edition with extra marks is a.

domains.summary: An abugida is a consonant with a default vowel, plus ticks. Devanagari as a classroom example. A virama/killer kills the vowel. It is not ‘an alphabet with decorations’.

domains.summary: A syllabary has a symbol per syllable (sort of). Kana (Japanese) is the friendly example; kanji is the other half of that story. Cherokee has a syllabary with a history of.

domains.summary: A character can carry a morpheme more than a sound. Chinese characters as the famous case. Phonetic components still hide inside many. It is not a drawing of a sheep every time.

domains.summary: A loanword is a suitcase that gets relabelled. Café, tsunami, kangaroo (a famous messy etymology). The suitcase can change meaning in the new house (a ‘handy’ in German).

domains.summary: A false friend is a trap with a smile. Gift in German is poison. Preservative in a Romance language can be a condom story. Dictionaries exist.

domains.title: Meanings drift like continents, slower and weirder
domains.summary: Meanings drift like continents, slower and weirder. Nice once meant ignorant-ish. Awful was full of awe. A prescriptivist can cry; a historian can take notes.

domains.summary: We live in metaphors we forgot were metaphors. Time as money, argument as war. A language can prefer a different metaphor (time as a landscape). Lakoff is a door, not a religion.

domains.summary: Honorifics are grammar plus a social map. Who is older, a customer, a teacher. Dropping them can be intimacy or an insult. A textbook will simplify; a drama will not.

domains.summary: A taboo word is a social high-voltage. Swearing, a sacred name, a death word. Borrowing a slur you do not own is not ‘just a word’ because Saussure said arbitrary. Arbitrary ≠.

domains.summary: Kinship words are a map of who matters. Some languages split uncle into mother’s brother vs father’s. English is poor here. A ‘cousin’ can be a brother in a way that is not a.

domains.summary: A gesture can be a word, and a trap at an airport. Thumbs-up, a OK circle, a nod that means no in some places. Emblems are language-like. Beat gestures are different.

domains.summary: Immersion is not a holiday with a beach. Hours, a need to speak, a community. A two-week tour can be English in a different kitchen. Change the phone, the friends, the fear.

domains.summary: Open source is a licence and a peek, not automatically safe. You can read it; you might not. A supply-chain npm was a parable. A school project can still use it with a citation..

domains.summary: A coin with a story is often a story with your money. A ‘guaranteed’, a celebrity, a seed phrase someone asks for. This is not investment advice — it is a trap map. The business.

domains.summary: A live location is a map of a body. Find My, a story map, a ‘come find me’ that stays on. A ex, a stranger, a burglar who knows you are at a film. Off when the meet is done.

domains.summary: A page can vanish; a archive might not. Wayback, a citation, a ‘we never said that’. Also: a archive of a harm that should not be copied. Ethics of saving. A school assignment.

domains.summary: A moderator is a volunteer court with burnout. Rules, a mute, a ban. You can appeal without a pile-on of the mod. A ‘free speech’ that is a slush of slurs is a different product..

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SO-DIMM will not fake a DIMM slot
domains.summary: SO-DIMM will not fake a DIMM slot. SO-DIMM is a smaller outline with a different notch. A desktop DIMM does not clip into a laptop, even if both say DDR4.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: 2280 is a length, not a speed grade
domains.summary: 2280 is a length, not a speed grade. M.2 2230, 2242, 2260, and 2280 name millimetres of module length. A 2280 stick will not sit in a 2242-only bracket without the right standoff.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A SATA SSD is a different conversation from NVMe
domains.summary: A SATA SSD is a different conversation from NVMe. 2.5-inch SATA and M.2 SATA speak AHCI over SATA. NVMe speaks PCIe. A SATA M.2 in an NVMe-only slot does nothing useful.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A PD print on a brick is a negotiation, not a wattage
domains.summary: A PD print on a brick is a negotiation, not a wattage. USB Power Delivery profiles are a handshake. 20 V at 5 A needs an e-marked 5 A cable. A 65 W laptop may refuse a cheap 20 W.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Store Li-ion near half, not full or flat
domains.summary: Store Li-ion near half, not full or flat. Calendar ageing is faster at 100% and at hot shelves. Shops store packs around 40–60% if they will sit. Do not freeze a pack to.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth often share one M.2 card
domains.summary: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth often share one M.2 card. Many laptops use a combo CNVi or M.2 card. One antenna lead is Wi-Fi, one is Bluetooth/aux. Swapping ‘just Wi-Fi’ can kill BT in.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: The antennas live in the lid, not the palm rest
domains.summary: The antennas live in the lid, not the palm rest. Wi-Fi traces run through the hinge. A cracked hinge or a pinched eDP/antenna bundle is a one-bar ticket after a drop.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A DC jack is a mechanical fuse
domains.summary: A DC jack is a mechanical fuse. Barrel jacks fatigue. A wiggle-to-charge laptop is often the jack, not the brick. USB-C PD machines still have board-side controllers that burn.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: 80 Plus is efficiency, not a 12 V promise
domains.summary: 80 Plus is efficiency, not a 12 V promise. 80 Plus Bronze/Gold says how much wall power becomes DC at a test load. A Gold 450 W unit can still starve a GPU’s 12 V rail.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: WWAN is a card plus an antenna plus a SIM path
domains.summary: WWAN is a card plus an antenna plus a SIM path. LTE/5G in a laptop needs a WWAN-ready M.2 slot (often 3042/3052), antennas in the lid, and a SIM or eSIM. A Wi-Fi slot is not a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A digitizer is not the LCD
domains.summary: A digitizer is not the LCD. Glass/digitizer is the touch surface. The LCD/OLED is the image. A cracked glass with a perfect picture is not ‘a new screen’ as one blob unless the.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Cycle count is wear, not a calendar curse
domains.summary: Cycle count is wear, not a calendar curse. A cycle is roughly a full 0–100 in pieces. 80% health at 400 cycles can be normal. A 2-year pack at 99% that swells is still a safety.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: The eDP cable is a hinge victim
domains.summary: The eDP cable is a hinge victim. Flicker on lid angle is often the eDP/LVDS cable, not a GPU that hates Tuesdays. Reseat both ends; do not yank the panel clips.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: CRU is customer; FRU is the shop
domains.summary: CRU is customer; FRU is the shop. CRUs are the bits the vendor expects a careful owner to swap (some batteries, SODIMMs). FRUs may need torque maps and hidden clips.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A laptop keyboard is a ribbon, not a USB stick
domains.summary: A laptop keyboard is a ribbon, not a USB stick. ZIF/FFC cables hate a 45-degree yank. A few keys dead in a rectangle is often the membrane; a whole matrix dead is the cable or.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Haptic pads are a board, not a click plastic
domains.summary: Haptic pads are a board, not a click plastic. Precision touchpads and haptic engines need the right driver and a seated cable. A ‘dead click’ can be firmware or a bent plate, not.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A shutter is not a driver, and a driver is not a shutter
domains.summary: A shutter is not a driver, and a driver is not a shutter. Hardware shutters block the lens. A kill-switch can cut the USB camera device. A missing camera in Device Manager after.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SIM and eSIM are different doors
domains.summary: SIM and eSIM are different doors. A nano-SIM tray is not an eSIM profile. WWAN still needs the radio. A phone hotspot is a workaround, not a SIM slot.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Qi is a coil alignment job
domains.summary: Qi is a coil alignment job. Wireless charge needs a coil over a coil and a case that is not a magnet museum. Foreign-object detection will cut power rather than cook a coin.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: IMEI is the radio; serial is the chassis
domains.summary: IMEI is the radio; serial is the chassis. IMEI/MEID identify the cellular identity. A laptop serial is a warranty name. MDM and blacklists key off the right one.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Activation Lock is not a forgotten PIN
domains.summary: Activation Lock is not a forgotten PIN. Find My / Knox / Android Factory Reset Protection ties the device to an identity. A wipe without the owner is a brick with a progress bar.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A microSD is not the 256 GB in the spec sheet
domains.summary: A microSD is not the 256 GB in the spec sheet. Phone/tablet soldered UFS is the internal store. A card is extra, slower, and easy to eject into a washing machine.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: OTG is a host hat, not a charge brick
domains.summary: OTG is a host hat, not a charge brick. USB-OTG/USB-C dual-role lets a phone talk to a stick. A charge-only cable will not. Some phones need a setting or a proper OTG dongle.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: CTIA vs OMTP is why one mic is silent
domains.summary: CTIA vs OMTP is why one mic is silent. TRRS headsets wire mic and ground differently. A 3-pole TRS guitar lead is not a headset. USB-C analog adapters are their own mess.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: NFC is a tap field, not Wi-Fi
domains.summary: NFC is a tap field, not Wi-Fi. NFC is centimetres, for pairing and payments. It is not a file pipe. Android Beam nostalgia is not how you move a 4 GB video.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Lightning and USB-C are not ‘a cable’
domains.summary: Lightning and USB-C are not ‘a cable’. Pins, authentication chips, and PD rules differ. A Lightning brick with a USB-C plug on the wall side is still a Lightning conversation at.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: IP68 is not a diving licence for a charging port
domains.summary: IP68 is not a diving licence for a charging port. Ingress ratings are lab tests. A wet USB-C port can corrode or refuse charge. Liquid contacts indicators exist for a reason.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A phone that won’t sit flat is a pack, not a case
domains.summary: A phone that won’t sit flat is a pack, not a case. Li-ion swell lifts screens. Heat and cheap cases bake it. Do not clamp, puncture, or ‘massage’ it flat.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Ghost touch is often glass, moisture, or a case
domains.summary: Ghost touch is often glass, moisture, or a case. Phantom taps can be a cracked digitizer, a wet screen protector, or a metal plate case. A software calibration is a maybe, not a.

domains.summary: A mux switch is why HDMI might ignore the RTX. Advanced Optimus / muxed laptops can drive the panel from iGPU or dGPU. An HDMI port soldered to the iGPU will not ‘see’ the.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: The coin cell is a clock, not a Windows password
domains.summary: The coin cell is a clock, not a Windows password. CR2032 keeps RTC and some BIOS settings. A dead cell is ‘wrong time every boot’, not a dead CPU.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Pins live on the CPU or the board, not both as a vibe
domains.summary: Pins live on the CPU or the board, not both as a vibe. AM4/AM5 put pins on the CPU (PGA). Intel desktop LGA puts lands on the CPU and pins in the socket. A bent socket pin is a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SFX is not a cute ATX
domains.summary: SFX is not a cute ATX. ATX, SFX, TFX, FlexATX are shapes and mounting. An SFX-L may still need a bracket. Cables are not always the same kit.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: CPU 8-pin is not a GPU 8-pin in spirit
domains.summary: CPU 8-pin is not a GPU 8-pin in spirit. EPS12V/ATX12V CPU power and PCIe GPU power can look like cousins. The pinout and the side they feed are not interchangeable as a lifestyle.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A DRAM-less NVMe still needs air, not a sticker
domains.summary: A DRAM-less NVMe still needs air, not a sticker. DRAM cache vs HMB is a performance personality. A heatsink can be required to stop thermal throttle. A pretty heatsink that hits.
