domains.title: XMP/EXPO is an overclock with a brochure
domains.summary: XMP/EXPO is an overclock with a brochure. JEDEC is the safe table. XMP/EXPO is a vendor profile. A kit can POST at JEDEC and fail at the pretty number on the heat spreader.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SATA data is not SATA power
domains.summary: SATA data is not SATA power. The L-shaped data lead is not the wide power lead. A 3.3 V pin on some power cables can keep a disk from spinning (the ‘orange wire’ folklore has a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Molex-to-SATA adapters are a fire rumour with a body count
domains.summary: Molex-to-SATA adapters are a fire rumour with a body count. Cheap moulded Molex-to-SATA can miswire 12 V onto 5 V. That is a disk fryer. Use the PSU’s native SATA power.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: PCIe slots are not structural beams
domains.summary: PCIe slots are not structural beams. A heavy card twists the slot. Sag braces exist. A cracked slot is a board, not a driver.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Intake and exhaust are a path, not a fan count
domains.summary: Intake and exhaust are a path, not a fan count. Front/bottom in, rear/top out is a common plan. Fighting fans make turbulence and dust sculptures. Mesh vs glass is a thermal.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Throttle is a temperature policy, not a crash
domains.summary: Throttle is a temperature policy, not a crash. CPUs and GPUs slow clocks to stay in a TDP box. A game at 30 fps with a quiet fan curve can be a thermal limit, not a ‘dead GPU’.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: B-key, M-key, and B+M are not a mood
domains.summary: B-key, M-key, and B+M are not a mood. M-key NVMe uses PCIe. B-key is often SATA or WWAN. A B+M SATA stick will not run NVMe speeds in an M-key slot just because it fits loosely.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: AHCI vs RAID in BIOS is a boot personality
domains.summary: AHCI vs RAID in BIOS is a boot personality. Intel RST RAID mode needs drivers at install. Flip to AHCI after install without the right dance and you get INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: ×16 is a lane budget, not a promise to every slot
domains.summary: ×16 is a lane budget, not a promise to every slot. CPU and chipset share lanes. A second ×16 slot may be ×8/×4/×1 when an NVMe is filled. Bifurcation is a BIOS feature, not a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: AM4 brackets are not LGA 1700 brackets
domains.summary: AM4 brackets are not LGA 1700 brackets. Mounting kits are socket-specific. An offset ILM and a wrong bracket is a crushed corner or a spinning fan with no contact.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Power SW is two pins, not a rainbow
domains.summary: Power SW is two pins, not a rainbow. Front-panel HD-AUDIO, USB, and the tiny power/reset cluster are easy to swap. A PC that ‘won’t power on’ with a working PSU is often the.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Cat6A is a spec, not a colour of plastic
domains.summary: Cat6A is a spec, not a colour of plastic. Cat5e/6/6a differ in bandwidth and alien crosstalk. 10G over copper wants Cat6A for the full 100 m story. A flat ‘Cat6’ from a bargain.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A and B are pinouts, not quality grades
domains.summary: A and B are pinouts, not quality grades. T568A and T568B swap the orange and green pairs. A cable with A on one end and B on the other is a crossover, which modern NICs usually.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: PoE is a budget, not a personality
domains.summary: PoE is a budget, not a personality. 802.3af/at/bt are watt classes. A switch with 60 W total cannot feed eight 15 W cameras. Unmanaged ‘PoE’ injectors are still a power supply.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz are different rooms
domains.summary: 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz are different rooms. 2.4 goes further and is crowded. 5/6 are faster and die on brick. A ‘Wi-Fi 6’ AP still has a 2.4 radio that can be a swamp.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: 80 MHz is a width, not a speed cheat code
domains.summary: 80 MHz is a width, not a speed cheat code. 20/40/80/160 MHz eat more spectrum. Neighbours and DFS make wide channels flake. A quiet 40 can beat a screaming 80.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: DFS channels can go on holiday
domains.summary: DFS channels can go on holiday. Some 5 GHz channels must yield to radar. The AP vacates, clients sulk. A ‘Wi-Fi died for 10 minutes’ can be DFS, not a WAN outage.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: MAC is the nametag; IP is the address for today
domains.summary: MAC is the nametag; IP is the address for today. L2 uses MAC. L3 uses IP. A reservation is DHCP tying an IP to a MAC. Cloning a MAC to steal a reservation is a ticket, not a skill.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: The gateway is the door off this subnet
domains.summary: The gateway is the door off this subnet. No default gateway means local-only. A wrong gateway is a confident path into a wall. Traceroute is the story, not ipconfig as poetry.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: /24 is 256 addresses, not 24 hosts
domains.summary: /24 is 256 addresses, not 24 hosts. A mask of 255.255.255.0 is /24: 254 usable in the usual private tale. /16 is a different size. Writing 255.255.255.255 as a host mask is a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A crimp is a plug; a punchdown is a block
domains.summary: A crimp is a plug; a punchdown is a block. RJ45 plugs are crimped. Keystone/patch panels are punched. A ‘crimp a wall jack’ is how you invent a mystery fail.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: LC, SC, and ST are ferrule religions
domains.summary: LC, SC, and ST are ferrule religions. LC is small and latchy, SC is square, ST is twist-bayonet. The fibre type (OS2 vs OM3/4) is the other half of the ticket.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Single-mode is not ‘better multi’
domains.summary: Single-mode is not ‘better multi’. OS2 single-mode is a different core and laser. OM3/OM4 multimode is VCSEL-friendly. An SMF SFP in MMF (or the reverse) is a dim link, not a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SFP and SFP+ are cousins, not twins
domains.summary: SFP and SFP+ are cousins, not twins. SFP is 1G. SFP+ is 10G. Some cages accept both; some optics will not clock down. A copper 10G DAC is a cable with SFP+ ends, not a miracle.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A loopback plug tests the NIC, not the universe
domains.summary: A loopback plug tests the NIC, not the universe. An RJ45 loopback ties TX to RX. A good NIC can show link without a switch. It does not prove the wall run.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Tone and probe find a pair, not a subnet
domains.summary: Tone and probe find a pair, not a subnet. A toner sings on a pair. A probe hears it in a bundle. It will not tell you VLAN 40 from VLAN 50.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: No link light is a layer-1 sentence
domains.summary: No link light is a layer-1 sentence. Speed LED vs link LED vs activity. A cable with a broken TX can still look pretty. Autoneg fail is a duplex cousin of this ticket.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: An unmanaged switch has no VLAN opinions
domains.summary: An unmanaged switch has no VLAN opinions. Unmanaged is a dumb repeater of frames (plus maybe jumbo). VLANs, QoS, and ‘guest’ live on managed boxes. A $30 8-port will not isolate.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Sticky clients hug a weak AP
domains.summary: Sticky clients hug a weak AP. Phones hold a familiar BSSID until it is awful. Fast roaming (11r/k/v) is a design, not a checkbox you tick without testing.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A captive portal is a hijack with a form
domains.summary: A captive portal is a hijack with a form. HTTPS can look ‘broken’ until the portal is satisfied. Some clients need a random HTTP hit. It is not a CA failure first.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Fast Startup is a hybrid hibernation
domains.summary: Fast Startup is a hybrid hibernation. Windows Fast Startup skips a cold kernel. Driver and firmware tickets can hide until you shut down for real. ‘Restart’ and ‘Shut down’ are.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: GPT is the modern map; MBR is the 2 TB museum
domains.summary: GPT is the modern map; MBR is the 2 TB museum. UEFI wants GPT for Windows on most PCs. MBR plus CSM is a compatibility hat. A 4 TB disk with MBR wastes a future.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: CSM is a backwards hat, not a speed boost
domains.summary: CSM is a backwards hat, not a speed boost. Compatibility Support Module emulates BIOS. Secure Boot wants UEFI native. A ‘no bootable device’ after a board swap is often CSM vs GPT.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: WinRE is on the disk; install media is a USB
domains.summary: WinRE is on the disk; install media is a USB. WinRE can be broken if the recovery partition is toast. A full ISO on USB is a different toolkit. Reset this PC still needs a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A file system is a contract with an OS
domains.summary: A file system is a contract with an OS. NTFS is Windows-native with permissions. exFAT is a camera/USB peace treaty. APFS is Apple. Linux ext4 will look like ‘format?’ in Explorer.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: The pagefile is not free RAM
domains.summary: The pagefile is not free RAM. When RAM is full, Windows pages. A tiny SSD with no pagefile will hard-fail before it politely slows. Task Manager’s ‘compressed’ is another cousin.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: hiberfil.sys is a sleep souvenir
domains.summary: hiberfil.sys is a sleep souvenir. Hibernate writes RAM to disk. Disable hibernate to reclaim the file. Fast Startup uses a related trick. A full disk can be this file, not photos.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: clean is a murder; format is a haircut
domains.summary: clean is a murder; format is a haircut. diskpart clean drops the partition table. format drops a volume’s files. The wrong disk index is a career event.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: SMC/T2/reset dances are model-specific
domains.summary: SMC/T2/reset dances are model-specific. Apple power/SMC/NVRAM resets are not one Google result. Apple silicon made some of these museum steps. A wrong hold can just reboot.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A live USB is a test hat, not an install
domains.summary: A live USB is a test hat, not an install. Booting a live image proves CPU/RAM/display without touching the disk — until you hit Install. Persistent live vs full install is a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Secure Boot is a signature chain, not an antivirus
domains.summary: Secure Boot is a signature chain, not an antivirus. The firmware checks bootloaders against keys. Dual-boot dances and some GPUs trip it. Turning it off to ‘make Linux work’ is a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A firmware password is not the user PIN
domains.summary: A firmware password is not the user PIN. Supervisor/BIOS passwords gate settings and sometimes boot. Windows Hello is a different lock. Clearing CMOS may or may not drop the.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Suspend is not decrypt
domains.summary: Suspend is not decrypt. Suspend BitLocker for a firmware change so TPM measurements can change without a recovery prompt. Decrypt is a full wipe of the protector scheme.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A cable lock is delay, not a vault
domains.summary: A cable lock is delay, not a vault. Kensington slots slow a grab-and-run. They do not stop a determined person with time. Policy still wants encryption and a lock screen.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A privacy filter is geometry, not magic glass
domains.summary: A privacy filter is geometry, not magic glass. Microlouvres cut side angles. They do not stop a camera behind you. Brightness will look worse; that is the trade.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A bin disk is still a disk
domains.summary: A bin disk is still a disk. Decommissioned HDDs in office bins are a classic leak. Policy wants wipe or shred with a record.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A BIOS file from a forum is an incident
domains.summary: A BIOS file from a forum is an incident. Firmware needs integrity. Vendors sign updates. A ‘unlocked’ BIOS is how you own a fleet.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: RMA packing is part of the repair
domains.summary: RMA packing is part of the repair. A GPU in a bag in a box without a brace is a new fault. ESD bags, foam, and the original serial photo live here.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: An IR gun is a spot; a camera is a map
domains.summary: An IR gun is a spot; a camera is a map. A cheap pyrometer averages a spot and lies on shiny metal. A thermal camera finds a hot VRM or a cold pump. Emissivity is a real knob.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Cannibalising is a loan with a serial
domains.summary: Cannibalising is a loan with a serial. A RAM stick from a waiting unit must be tagged back. Otherwise you invent two faults and one mystery.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A loaner is an asset, not a souvenir
domains.summary: A loaner is an asset, not a souvenir. Loaners need images, asset tags, and a wipe on return. A user’s files on a loaner is a privacy ticket.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Reload is a last hat, not a first spell
domains.summary: Reload is a last hat, not a first spell. An OS reload without a file pass is how you become a story. Browser profiles and PST files hide.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: An in-place repair is not a golden image
domains.summary: An in-place repair is not a golden image. In-place upgrade keeps apps and can fix component store rot. A golden image is a known baseline. They answer different tickets.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Air moves dust; a vacuum at the intake catches it
domains.summary: Air moves dust; a vacuum at the intake catches it. Canned air inside a laptop without a vacuum nearby paints the room and the fans in reverse. Hold fans so they do not become.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A screw map is a document, not a memory sport
domains.summary: A screw map is a document, not a memory sport. Laptop screws differ in length by 1 mm and will punch a board. Photos and a grid beat a pile.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Seated is a click, not ‘it went in’
domains.summary: Seated is a click, not ‘it went in’. Display, battery, and M.2 cables can look seated and not be. A backlight flicker after a ‘resit’ is this.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: No POST is not no boot
domains.summary: No POST is not no boot. No POST: no logo, maybe beeps, fans may spin. No boot: POST then a disk/OS story. Mixing them wastes hours.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Intermittent wants a log; hard fail wants a swap
domains.summary: Intermittent wants a log; hard fail wants a swap. A once-a-week freeze is heat, power, or a driver. A never-POSTs is RAM/board/CPU/power. Treat them differently.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A warranty sticker is not always the law
domains.summary: A warranty sticker is not always the law. Some regions limit void-for-sticker games. Still: liquid indicators and impact are real. ACL in Australia has opinions vendors sometimes.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A quote is a cap; T&M is a meter
domains.summary: A quote is a cap; T&M is a meter. Time and materials without a written cap is how a $90 DC jack becomes a $600 board plus labour. Say the risk before the screwdriver.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A swapped disk still has their life on it
domains.summary: A swapped disk still has their life on it. RMA and ‘dead’ NVMe units hold data. Policy: wipe, encrypt-at-rest, or destroy. A ‘it doesn’t enumerate’ disk can still be imaged in a.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Continuity is a beep, not a voltage
domains.summary: Continuity is a beep, not a voltage. Ohms/continuity with power off. Voltage with power on and a plan. Measuring 12 V in continuity mode is how you learn about fuse icons.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A paperclip test is a spin, not a load test
domains.summary: A paperclip test is a spin, not a load test. Jumping PS_ON on ATX can spin a fan. It does not prove 12 V under a GPU. A shorted board can still twitch a fan.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: Toner is a powder with rules
domains.summary: Toner is a powder with rules. Do not vacuum toner with a home vac (fine dust + static). Skin and lungs are not a filter spec. Laser techs use rated vacs.

domains.subject: tech
domains.title: A police PC is not a normal bench ticket
domains.summary: A police PC is not a normal bench ticket. Legal holds and HR seizures need a chain: who touched it, when, and whether you powered it. Curiosity is a discovery event.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Face value is the digit; place is the chair
domains.summary: Face value is the digit; place is the chair. In 4 080 the first 4 is four thousands, the 8 is eight tens. Face value of 8 is 8; place value is 80.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Divisible by 3 is a digit-sum test
domains.summary: Divisible by 3 is a digit-sum test. A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is. 147 → 1+4+7=12, and 12 is a multiple of 3.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: HCF is the biggest shared factor, not the friendliest
domains.summary: HCF is the biggest shared factor, not the friendliest. HCF/GCD of 12 and 18 is 6. It is the largest number that divides both. A Venn of prime factors is a picture, not a vibe.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: LCM is the next time both buses arrive
domains.summary: LCM is the next time both buses arrive. LCM of 4 and 6 is 12. Least common multiple, not ‘least common factor’ (that phrase is a trap).

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A prime has exactly two distinct factors
domains.summary: A prime has exactly two distinct factors. 7 is 1 and 7. 1 is not prime: it has one factor. 9 is 1,3,9 — composite. 2 is the even prime, not a scandal.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: × and ÷ share a rung; + and − share a rung
domains.summary: × and ÷ share a rung; + and − share a rung. Left to right on the same precedence. 8÷2×4 is 16, not 1. Brackets still win first.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Minus a minus is a plus, because direction
domains.summary: Minus a minus is a plus, because direction. 3 − (−2) is 3 + 2. You walked left of left. −3 + (−2) is −5. The signs are a number-line story, not a decoration.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Absolute value is distance from zero
domains.summary: Absolute value is distance from zero. |−4| = 4. Distance is not negative. |a−b| is how far a is from b, either way.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Factors go in; multiples come out
domains.summary: Factors go in; multiples come out. 3 is a factor of 12. 12 is a multiple of 3. People swap the words and then fail a worded question.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A rough estimate is a lie detector
domains.summary: A rough estimate is a lie detector. 19.6 × 4.9 is about 20 × 5 = 100. A calculator 960 is a missed point. Estimation is not cheating; it is a check.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A square number is an n by n array
domains.summary: A square number is an n by n array. 5² = 25 is a square of dots. 6² − 5² = 11, not a random jump. Squares grow by odd numbers.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A cube is n × n × n, not n × 3
domains.summary: A cube is n × n × n, not n × 3. 2³ = 8, 3³ = 27. Volume of a cube of side 3 is 27 cubes, not 9.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Consecutive integers differ by 1
domains.summary: Consecutive integers differ by 1. n, n+1, n+2. Their sum is 3n+3 if three of them. Even consecutives differ by 2.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A remainder is leftover wholes, not a decimal
domains.summary: A remainder is leftover wholes, not a decimal. 17 ÷ 5 = 3 remainder 2. That is 3 + 2/5, not remainder 0.4 as a leftover object.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: One even factor makes the product even
domains.summary: One even factor makes the product even. Even × anything integer is even. Odd × odd is odd. 2k is the even costume.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Equivalent fractions are the same amount, different slices
domains.summary: Equivalent fractions are the same amount, different slices. 1/2 = 2/4 = 50/100. You multiplied (or divided) top and bottom by the same non-zero number.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Lowest terms means the HCF of top and bottom is 1
domains.summary: Lowest terms means the HCF of top and bottom is 1. 18/24 ÷6 = 3/4. You are not making it smaller in value; you are writing a neater name.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A mixed number is a whole plus a leftover fraction
domains.summary: A mixed number is a whole plus a leftover fraction. 2 1/3 = 7/3 because 2 = 6/3. Improper means numerator ≥ denominator, not ‘wrong’.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Unlike denominators need a common slice size
domains.summary: Unlike denominators need a common slice size. 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6. The LCD is an LCM of the denominators.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Subtracting mixed numbers may need a borrow of one whole
domains.summary: Subtracting mixed numbers may need a borrow of one whole. 5 1/4 − 2 3/4: you cannot take 3 from 1 in that costume. Rewrite 5 1/4 as 4 5/4, then subtract.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Multiply fractions: tops together, bottoms together
domains.summary: Multiply fractions: tops together, bottoms together. 2/3 × 4/5 = 8/15. Cancel common factors before you multiply if you want smaller numbers.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Dividing by a fraction is multiply by its reciprocal
domains.summary: Dividing by a fraction is multiply by its reciprocal. 2/3 ÷ 4/5 = 2/3 × 5/4. You are asking how many 4/5 fit in 2/3.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Of a quantity is multiply, then interpret the unit
domains.summary: Of a quantity is multiply, then interpret the unit. 3/4 of 24 is 18. 3/4 of $24 is $18. The unit survives.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Compare fractions with a common denominator or a cross-multiply
domains.summary: Compare fractions with a common denominator or a cross-multiply. 3/7 vs 2/5: 15 vs 14, so 3/7 is larger. Same numerator: bigger denominator is smaller pieces.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A reciprocal is the flip that multiplies to 1
domains.summary: A reciprocal is the flip that multiplies to 1. The reciprocal of 2/3 is 3/2. Of 5 is 1/5. Of 0 does not exist.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Terminating decimals have only 2s and 5s in the denominator’s primes
domains.summary: Terminating decimals have only 2s and 5s in the denominator’s primes. 1/8 = 0.125 ends. 1/6 = 0.1666… repeats. After simplifying, look at the denominator’s prime factors.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A fraction bigger than 1 is still a fraction
domains.summary: A fraction bigger than 1 is still a fraction. 9/4 is 2 1/4. Improper is a costume. On a number line it sits past 1.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: KCF only applies to divide, and only the second fraction
domains.summary: KCF only applies to divide, and only the second fraction. Keep-change-flip is a mnemonic for ÷. Using it on + or × is how 1/2 + 1/3 becomes a crime.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A whole number is a fraction with denominator 1
domains.summary: A whole number is a fraction with denominator 1. 5 = 5/1 = 10/2. That is how 5 × 2/3 becomes 10/3 without a new rule.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Cross-multiplying is for equations (and comparisons), not for adding
domains.summary: Cross-multiplying is for equations (and comparisons), not for adding. If a/b = c/d then ad = bc (b,d ≠ 0). Adding 1/2 + 1/3 by cross-multiplying into 3+2 over 2×3 is actually LCD.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Percent is a fraction with a silent 100
domains.summary: Percent is a fraction with a silent 100. 17% = 17/100 = 0.17. The % is not a decoration; it moved the point two places.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: P% of N is P/100 × N
domains.summary: P% of N is P/100 × N. 15% of 80 is 12. 10% is a tenth; 5% is half of that. 1% is divide by 100.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Increase by p% is multiply by (1 + p/100)
domains.summary: Increase by p% is multiply by (1 + p/100). A $50 ticket up 10% is $55. You add 10% of the original, not 10% of a future number you have not got.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Decrease by p% is multiply by (1 − p/100)
domains.summary: Decrease by p% is multiply by (1 − p/100). A $80 jumper off 25% is $60. 25% of 80 is 20, then subtract.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: After a change, the new amount is not the original base
domains.summary: After a change, the new amount is not the original base. A price is $110 after 10% GST on the pre-GST amount: 110 = 1.1 × original, so original = 100. Do not take 10% of 110 and.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Two percent changes are multipliers in a row
domains.summary: Two percent changes are multipliers in a row. Up 10% then down 10% is ×1.1×0.9 = 0.99, a 1% loss, not back to start.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A percentage point is a subtraction of percents, not a percent of a percent
domains.summary: A percentage point is a subtraction of percents, not a percent of a percent. Interest from 4% to 5% rose 1 percentage point, which is a 25% relative rise. News often mixes these.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: GST-inclusive divides by 1.1 in Australia’s 10% story
domains.summary: GST-inclusive divides by 1.1 in Australia’s 10% story. A $22 meal with GST included: GST = 22 − 22/1.1 = $2. The 10% sits on the pre-tax amount.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Order of discount and GST is a policy, not a vibe
domains.summary: Order of discount and GST is a policy, not a vibe. 10% off then +GST is not always GST then 10% off. The receipt’s order is the contract.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Markup is on cost; margin is on price
domains.summary: Markup is on cost; margin is on price. Cost $40, sell $50: markup 25% on cost, margin 20% on price. Same dollars, different bases.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Percentage error is |estimate − true| / true × 100%
domains.summary: Percentage error is |estimate − true| / true × 100%. Guess 48, true 50: 4% error. The true value is the denominator, not the guess.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: More than 100% is allowed; it means more than one whole
domains.summary: More than 100% is allowed; it means more than one whole. 150% of 80 is 120. 200% is double. 0% is none. Negative percent is a decrease in a trench coat.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Sale price is a remainder percent of original
domains.summary: Sale price is a remainder percent of original. 20% off means you pay 80%. Original = sale / 0.8. A $64 sale was $80, not $64 + $20.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Two years of r% compound is ×(1+r)², not ×2r
domains.summary: Two years of r% compound is ×(1+r)², not ×2r. $1000 at 10% p.a. compound for 2 years is $1210. Simple would be $1200. The $10 is interest on interest.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A pie slice is a percent of 360°, not a percent of ‘looking big’
domains.summary: A pie slice is a percent of 360°, not a percent of ‘looking big’. 20% is 72°. The area (angle) carries the percent. A 3D exploding slice is a lie of emphasis.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: 1% is a bridge: find it, then scale
domains.summary: 1% is a bridge: find it, then scale. If 8% is 64, then 1% is 8, and 100% is 800. This undoes ‘percent of’ when you have the part.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A bar over digits marks the repeat, not a highlight
domains.summary: A bar over digits marks the repeat, not a highlight. 0.\overline{3} = 1/3. 0.\overline{12} = 12/99. The bar’s length is the period.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: 0.09 is nine hundredths; 0.1 is one tenth
domains.summary: 0.09 is nine hundredths; 0.1 is one tenth. 0.10 = 0.1 > 0.09. Extra zeros after the last non-zero do not help 0.09 catch 0.1.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A terminating decimal is a fraction over a power of 10
domains.summary: A terminating decimal is a fraction over a power of 10. 0.375 = 375/1000 = 3/8. Simplify. Repeating decimals need the 9s (or algebra) method.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Cash rounding is a 5-cent story in Australia, cards are exact
domains.summary: Cash rounding is a 5-cent story in Australia, cards are exact. A $1.97 cash total may round to $1.95 or $2.00 depending on the rule in force. Card still takes $1.97. Rounding is.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: The third decimal place is thousandths
domains.summary: The third decimal place is thousandths. 0.007 is 7 thousandths, not 7 hundredths. 7 mm is 0.007 m. The zeros are chairs.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Per 60 minutes is still a divide
domains.summary: Per 60 minutes is still a divide. 90 km in 75 minutes is 90 ÷ 1.25 = 72 km/h, or 90 × 60/75. Units have to match before you divide.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Compare cents per 100 g, not the louder pack
domains.summary: Compare cents per 100 g, not the louder pack. 750 g for $5.40 vs 1 kg for $6.80: per 100 g is the shop’s honest column. Prominence is marketing.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: An exchange rate is a multiply or a divide, pick once
domains.summary: An exchange rate is a multiply or a divide, pick once. AUD to USD at 0.66 USD per AUD: multiply AUD by 0.66. The other way, divide. The rate’s sentence tells you.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Density is mass per volume, a rate with a name
domains.summary: Density is mass per volume, a rate with a name. ρ = m/V. 800 g in 1 L of a liquid is 0.8 g/mL. Oil floating on water is this number talking.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: 1 cm to 2 km is still a ratio; convert one unit first
domains.summary: 1 cm to 2 km is still a ratio; convert one unit first. 1:200 000 means 1 cm : 2 km. 4.5 cm → 9 km. Mixing cm with km without converting is the usual crash.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A ratio 2:3 is five parts if it is the whole
domains.summary: A ratio 2:3 is five parts if it is the whole. 2:3 of a $40 split is $16 and $24 if those parts make the whole. 2:3 can also mean 2 compared to 3 of something else — read the.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Average speed is total distance over total time
domains.summary: Average speed is total distance over total time. 50 km at 50 km/h then 50 km at 100 km/h is not 75 km/h. Times are 1 h and 0.5 h, total 1.5 h, average 100/1.5 ≈ 66.7 km/h.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Same base divide: subtract the indices
domains.summary: Same base divide: subtract the indices. a⁷ ÷ a² = a⁵. a ≠ 0. This is the multiply rule in reverse.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A power of a power multiplies the indices
domains.summary: A power of a power multiplies the indices. (a³)⁴ = a¹². (2³)² = 8² = 64 = 2⁶, not 2⁵.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A negative index is a reciprocal, not a negative number
domains.summary: A negative index is a reciprocal, not a negative number. a⁻² = 1/a². 2⁻³ = 1/8, not −8 and not −6.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A quadratic ax²+bx+c wants two numbers that multiply to ac and add to b
domains.summary: A quadratic ax²+bx+c wants two numbers that multiply to ac and add to b. 2x² + 7x + 3: numbers 6 and 1, split the middle, factor by grouping.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Completing the square is a rewrite, not a new equation
domains.summary: Completing the square is a rewrite, not a new equation. x² + 6x + 5 = (x+3)² − 9 + 5 = (x+3)² − 4. You add and subtract the same square.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: The quadratic formula is a completed square in a can
domains.summary: The quadratic formula is a completed square in a can. x = [−b ± √(b²−4ac)] / (2a). Discriminant D = b²−4ac tells you how many real roots.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Elimination adds equations to kill a variable
domains.summary: Elimination adds equations to kill a variable. If 2x+3y=7 and 2x+y=3, subtract: 2y=4. Same coefficient, opposite sign, add instead.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Substitution is solve one, plug into the other
domains.summary: Substitution is solve one, plug into the other. y = 2x+1 into 3x+y=10 → 3x+(2x+1)=10. Do not substitute into the same equation you solved.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: An inequality solution is a ray (or a segment), not always a point
domains.summary: An inequality solution is a ray (or a segment), not always a point. x > 3 is an open circle at 3 and an arrow. ≤ is filled. Combining two inequalities can be an AND segment.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: f(x) is a machine, not f times x
domains.summary: f(x) is a machine, not f times x. f(3) means plug 3 into the rule. f(x) = x² + 1, f(3) = 10. f(x+1) is a shift, not f(x)+1 automatically.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A geometric sequence multiplies by the same r each step
domains.summary: A geometric sequence multiplies by the same r each step. 2, 6, 18, 54… r=3. Term n is arⁿ⁻¹. r can be a fraction (decay) or negative (alternating).

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: The nth term of an arithmetic sequence is a + (n−1)d
domains.summary: The nth term of an arithmetic sequence is a + (n−1)d. 5, 8, 11, 14… a=5, d=3, Tₙ=3n+2. Check T₁. The ‘+2’ is not a coincidence; it is a−d.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Algebraic fractions need a common denominator too
domains.summary: Algebraic fractions need a common denominator too. 1/x + 1/(x+1) = [(x+1)+x]/[x(x+1)]. Domain: x≠0, x≠−1.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Making x the subject is undoing in reverse order
domains.summary: Making x the subject is undoing in reverse order. y = 3x+2 → y−2 = 3x → x=(y−2)/3. Inverse operations, both sides.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: If a²+b²=c², you have a right angle (converse)
domains.summary: If a²+b²=c², you have a right angle (converse). A 6-8-10 triangle is right-angled. 5-6-7 is not. The converse is a test, not a decoration.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: SOH CAH TOA names ratios, not a triangle’s personality
domains.summary: SOH CAH TOA names ratios, not a triangle’s personality. sin = opp/hyp, cos = adj/hyp, tan = opp/adj. The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle, always.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Elevation is up from horizontal; depression is down
domains.summary: Elevation is up from horizontal; depression is down. Angle of elevation from your eye to a kite. Depression from a cliff to a boat. They can be equal as alternate angles on.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Area of a circle is πr², not πd², not 2πr
domains.summary: Area of a circle is πr², not πd², not 2πr. 2πr is circumference. πr² is area. Diameter in the area formula needs r = d/2 first.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A sector is a pizza slice; an arc is the crust
domains.summary: A sector is a pizza slice; an arc is the crust. Fraction θ/360 of circumference or area (degrees). In radians, ½r²θ and rθ.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Similar areas scale with k²; volumes with k³
domains.summary: Similar areas scale with k²; volumes with k³. Lengths ×k, areas ×k², volumes ×k³. A k=2 statue uses 8 times the bronze, not 2.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Congruent is same shape and size; SSS/SAS/AAS/RHS are tests
domains.summary: Congruent is same shape and size; SSS/SAS/AAS/RHS are tests. AAA is similar, not congruent (scale can differ). SSA is the ambiguous swamp, not a standard school ticket to trust.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Corresponding, alternate, co-interior: names for a transversal
domains.summary: Corresponding, alternate, co-interior: names for a transversal. On parallel lines, corresponding are equal, alternate equal, co-interior add to 180°. If the lines are not.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Interior sum is (n−2)×180°, not n×180°
domains.summary: Interior sum is (n−2)×180°, not n×180°. A hexagon is 720°, not 1080°. Regular means equal, so divide by n for one interior angle.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Distance on the plane is Pythagoras on the run and rise
domains.summary: Distance on the plane is Pythagoras on the run and rise. d = √[(x₂−x₁)²+(y₂−y₁)²]. The squares kill the signs. Midpoint is average, a different tool.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Parallel lines share gradient; perpendiculars multiply to −1
domains.summary: Parallel lines share gradient; perpendiculars multiply to −1. m₁ = m₂ for parallel (unless vertical). m₁m₂ = −1 for perpendicular (neither vertical/horizontal pair of.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: The mode is the most frequent; it can be absent or many
domains.summary: The mode is the most frequent; it can be absent or many. 2,2,3,5,5,5,9: mode 5. Mean is a share. Bimodal is a thing. Categories can have a mode; they cannot have a mean without a.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A frequency table mean is Σ(fx)/Σf, not the mean of the x row
domains.summary: A frequency table mean is Σ(fx)/Σf, not the mean of the x row. If 10 people scored 3 and 2 scored 10, the mean is not 6.5. Weight by how many.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A grouped mean uses the midpoint as a stand-in
domains.summary: A grouped mean uses the midpoint as a stand-in. Class 10–20 with frequency 8 uses 15 as the ghost value. You lost the raw list; this is the cost.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Relative frequency is a fraction of the trials, an estimate of p
domains.summary: Relative frequency is a fraction of the trials, an estimate of p. 7 sixes in 60 rolls ≈ 7/60, not proof the die is fair or loaded by itself. More trials, closer (usually) to the.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A tree multiplies along a branch, adds across alternatives
domains.summary: A tree multiplies along a branch, adds across alternatives. With/without replacement changes the second-branch denominators. Write the probabilities on the edges.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Given that is a reduced sample space
domains.summary: Given that is a reduced sample space. P(A|B) = P(A and B)/P(B). ‘Of those who play sport, how many…’ is a row of a two-way table.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Quartiles split an ordered list into quarters, approximately
domains.summary: Quartiles split an ordered list into quarters, approximately. Methods differ on even n (include median or not). State the method. Q2 is the median.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: Standard deviation is a typical distance from the mean
domains.summary: Standard deviation is a typical distance from the mean. A small s means a tight pack. Units match the data. It is not the range, not the IQR, not a percent unless someone.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A percentile is a position in an ordered crowd
domains.summary: A percentile is a position in an ordered crowd. 80th percentile of heights means 80% of the group is shorter (give or take a definition). It is not ‘80% tall’.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A fair model is an assumption, not a personality test of the plastic
domains.summary: A fair model is an assumption, not a personality test of the plastic. P(6)=1/6 if we model fairness. A real die can be off. The model is the ‘if’.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: The sample space is the list of possible outcomes you are using
domains.summary: The sample space is the list of possible outcomes you are using. Two coins: {HH, HT, TH, TT} if order matters in your model. {2 heads, mix, 2 tails} is a different grouping with.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A truncated y-axis is a drama machine
domains.summary: A truncated y-axis is a drama machine. A bar chart that starts at 48 instead of 0 makes a 50-to-52 change look like a cliff. 3D pies and dual axes are cousins.

domains.subject: maths
domains.title: A census is everyone in the named group; a sample is a slice
domains.summary: A census is everyone in the named group; a sample is a slice. Australia’s Census tries a census of people in the country that night. A class poll of ‘Australians’ is a sample.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Mass is conserved in a closed flask, even when the look changes
domains.summary: Mass is conserved in a closed flask, even when the look changes. A precipitate or a gas still has mass. If the flask is closed, the total does not vanish because the mixture went.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Electron shells are energy addresses, not tiny planets
domains.summary: Electron shells are energy addresses, not tiny planets. Bohr’s rings are a model. Electrons do not circle like Neptune. Shells fill with a capacity (2, 8, 8…) as a first school.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: An ion is an atom (or group) that lost or gained electrons
domains.summary: An ion is an atom (or group) that lost or gained electrons. Na⁺ is not a sodium atom with a plus sticker for enthusiasm. The proton count stayed; the electron count did not.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Acid + metal often makes a salt and hydrogen
domains.summary: Acid + metal often makes a salt and hydrogen. Mg + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + H₂. The pop test is hydrogen, not ‘acid gas’. Unreactive metals (Cu, Au) shrug.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Neutralisation is acid + base → salt + water
domains.summary: Neutralisation is acid + base → salt + water. HCl + NaOH → NaCl + H₂O. Neutral is about H⁺ and OH⁻ pairing, not ‘the liquid looks calm’.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A more reactive metal can kick a less reactive ion out of solution
domains.summary: A more reactive metal can kick a less reactive ion out of solution. Fe in CuSO₄ grows a copper coat. The series is an empirical ladder, not a moral ranking.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Making bonds releases energy; breaking bonds costs it
domains.summary: Making bonds releases energy; breaking bonds costs it. Exothermic overall means the new bonds paid back more than the old bonds cost. A cold pack is the other way.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A balanced equation conserves atoms, not coefficients as a vibe
domains.summary: A balanced equation conserves atoms, not coefficients as a vibe. You may change numbers in front, not the little formulae. H₂O is not HO₂ because you needed even hydrogens.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A mole is a counted pile (Avogadro’s number), not a burrowing animal
domains.summary: A mole is a counted pile (Avogadro’s number), not a burrowing animal. 6.02 × 10²³ particles. Moles let you compare recipes. n = m/M is a later tool, but the idea is a count.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: How much can dissolve is not how fast it dissolves
domains.summary: How much can dissolve is not how fast it dissolves. Solubility is a maximum at a temperature. Stirring and surface area change rate, not the ceiling (unless temp/pressure changes).

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Allotropes are the same element in different structural costumes
domains.summary: Allotropes are the same element in different structural costumes. Diamond, graphite, graphene, buckminsterfullerene: all carbon. Hardness and conductivity differ because the.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Metals are a lattice of ions in a sea of delocalised electrons
domains.summary: Metals are a lattice of ions in a sea of delocalised electrons. That sea is why they conduct and why they are malleable: ions can slide, electrons keep the glue.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A polymer is a long chain of repeating monomers
domains.summary: A polymer is a long chain of repeating monomers. Polyethene is many ethene units. Plastics, proteins, and cellulose are polymer stories with different monomers.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Rust is iron oxidised with help from water and oxygen
domains.summary: Rust is iron oxidised with help from water and oxygen. Fe becomes Fe³⁺ oxides/hydroxides. Salt water speeds the electrochemical cell on the surface. Paint is a barrier, not a vibe.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Filtration catches insolubles; distillation rides boiling point
domains.summary: Filtration catches insolubles; distillation rides boiling point. Sand from salt water: filter. Salt from water: evaporate or distil. Ink dyes: chromatograph. The method matches.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: R_f is distance of the spot over distance of the solvent front
domains.summary: R_f is distance of the spot over distance of the solvent front. Chromatography separates because substances spend different time on paper vs solvent. R_f is a ratio ≤ 1.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A solar eclipse is the Moon covering the Sun; lunar is Earth’s shadow on the Moon
domains.summary: A solar eclipse is the Moon covering the Sun; lunar is Earth’s shadow on the Moon. Alignment: Sun–Moon–Earth for solar, Sun–Earth–Moon for lunar. Not every new moon, because the.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Solstices are the tilt extremes; equinoxes are the even-day crossings
domains.summary: Solstices are the tilt extremes; equinoxes are the even-day crossings. June solstice: Southern Hemisphere winter. Equinox: roughly equal day and night. Seasons are tilt, not.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A light-year is a distance, not a birthday
domains.summary: A light-year is a distance, not a birthday. The distance light travels in a year in vacuum. Proxima is about 4 ly. Looking far is looking back in time.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Redshift is a stretch of light from recession (often)
domains.summary: Redshift is a stretch of light from recession (often). Distant galaxies’ spectral lines shift red. Hubble’s observation: farther, faster away, on average. It is not ‘red because.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A constellation is a line-of-sight doodle, not a family of stars
domains.summary: A constellation is a line-of-sight doodle, not a family of stars. Stars in the Southern Cross are at different distances. They are not a cluster holding hands.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Earth’s magnetic field is a dynamo, not a bar magnet souvenir only
domains.summary: Earth’s magnetic field is a dynamo, not a bar magnet souvenir only. Molten outer core motion plus rotation. It shields against some solar wind. Magnetic north wanders; it is not.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: The troposphere is weather; the stratosphere holds the ozone layer we fuss about
domains.summary: The troposphere is weather; the stratosphere holds the ozone layer we fuss about. Temperature profile is not ‘colder as you go up’ forever. The stratosphere warms with ozone.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: An aquifer is stored water in rock pores, not an underground lake cartoon
domains.summary: An aquifer is stored water in rock pores, not an underground lake cartoon. Porosity and permeability. Over-pumping drops the water table. Recharge can be slow.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: El Niño and La Niña are Pacific patterns that shove Australia’s odds
domains.summary: El Niño and La Niña are Pacific patterns that shove Australia’s odds. El Niño: often drier for much of eastern Australia. La Niña: wetter odds. They are not a single thunderstorm.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Fire needs fuel, oxygen, and heat — and weather loads the dice
domains.summary: Fire needs fuel, oxygen, and heat — and weather loads the dice. Bushfire behaviour also wants dryness, wind, and slope. The triangle is the chemistry; the fire weather is the.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A tsunami is a water column shoved, often by an undersea quake
domains.summary: A tsunami is a water column shoved, often by an undersea quake. Not a tidal wave (tides are the Moon). A withdrawal of the sea can be a warning, not a bargain hunt.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Sticky magma traps gas and explodes; runny magma flows
domains.summary: Sticky magma traps gas and explodes; runny magma flows. Silica-rich (andesite/rhyolite) vs basaltic. Shield vs composite is a shape with a personality.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Soil is a living profile; dirt is soil out of place
domains.summary: Soil is a living profile; dirt is soil out of place. Horizons, organic matter, mineral bits, water, air, organisms. Erosion is the profile leaving.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Meteoroid in space, meteor in the sky, meteorite on the ground
domains.summary: Meteoroid in space, meteor in the sky, meteorite on the ground. The streak is heated air and ablating rock. Most never land as souvenirs.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A solar day is not quite a 360° spin relative to the stars
domains.summary: A solar day is not quite a 360° spin relative to the stars. Earth must spin a bit extra to face the Sun again. Sidereal day is shorter. This is why stars shift with seasons at a.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Ozone depletion is not the same dial as the greenhouse effect
domains.summary: Ozone depletion is not the same dial as the greenhouse effect. Ozone (stratosphere) blocks UV. Greenhouse gases (troposphere mainly) trap IR. CFCs were an ozone villain and also.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: An enzyme is a shape-specific catalyst, usually a protein
domains.summary: An enzyme is a shape-specific catalyst, usually a protein. Lock-and-key / induced fit: the active site holds the substrate. Heat and pH can denature the shape, and then the job.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Blood type is antigens on red cells plus antibodies in plasma
domains.summary: Blood type is antigens on red cells plus antibodies in plasma. Type A has A antigens. Transfusion fights are immune, not ‘the blood was the wrong colour’.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Red cells carry oxygen; white cells fight; platelets plug
domains.summary: Red cells carry oxygen; white cells fight; platelets plug. Haemoglobin is the iron-containing oxygen taxi. Anaemia is a capacity story. WBC are immune; they are not ‘white.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A reflex can close in the spinal cord before you ‘decide’
domains.summary: A reflex can close in the spinal cord before you ‘decide’. Receptor → sensory neuron → relay → motor → effector. Pain arrives in the brain a beat later. Speed is the point.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Insulin is a signal to store/use glucose, not the sugar itself
domains.summary: Insulin is a signal to store/use glucose, not the sugar itself. High blood glucose → pancreas (beta cells) → insulin → cells take up glucose. Glucagon is the opposite dial.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A vaccine trains memory cells without giving you the full disease job
domains.summary: A vaccine trains memory cells without giving you the full disease job. Antigen exposure (weakened, killed, or a piece) → memory. Later infection is a faster, bigger antibody.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Antibiotics target bacteria; viruses do not have those targets
domains.summary: Antibiotics target bacteria; viruses do not have those targets. Cell walls, bacterial ribosomes. A cold is usually viral. Resistance is evolution in a dish we keep feeding.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: DNA stores; RNA is often the working copy
domains.summary: DNA stores; RNA is often the working copy. DNA is double-stranded in the nucleus (eukaryotes). mRNA carries a codon copy to ribosomes. T vs U is a letter swap.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A chromosome is a package; a gene is a recipe on it
domains.summary: A chromosome is a package; a gene is a recipe on it. Humans: 46 chromosomes in body cells, 23 in gametes. Genes are loci. Alleles are versions.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Dominant is expressed with one copy; recessive needs two — in the simple model
domains.summary: Dominant is expressed with one copy; recessive needs two — in the simple model. Dominant does not mean common or healthy. A rare dominant can be rare. Recessive can hide in.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Valves stop backflow; they are doors, not pumps
domains.summary: Valves stop backflow; they are doors, not pumps. AV valves between atria and ventricles; semilunar to arteries. A murmur can be turbulence. The muscle is the pump.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Capillaries are the exchange shop; arteries are the highway
domains.summary: Capillaries are the exchange shop; arteries are the highway. Thin walls, slow flow, huge area. Oxygen, CO₂, glucose, wastes. Arteries are high pressure pipes, not the swap meet.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Peristalsis is a muscle wave, not gravity’s kindness
domains.summary: Peristalsis is a muscle wave, not gravity’s kindness. You can swallow in weird orientations because circular/longitudinal muscle pushes a bolus. The gut is not a chute you.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Nerves are fast and targeted; hormones are slower and broadcast
domains.summary: Nerves are fast and targeted; hormones are slower and broadcast. Adrenaline can be both a nerve ending chemical and a blood hormone. The endocrine system is a radio; the nervous.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: The liver is a chemical factory, not just a filter sticker
domains.summary: The liver is a chemical factory, not just a filter sticker. It makes bile, stores glycogen, processes drugs/alcohol, makes proteins. ‘Detox tea’ is not a spare liver.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Kinetic energy grows with speed squared, not linearly
domains.summary: Kinetic energy grows with speed squared, not linearly. KE = ½mv². Double speed, quadruple KE. Braking distance stories live here. Mass is linear.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Gravitational potential energy is mgh near Earth’s surface
domains.summary: Gravitational potential energy is mgh near Earth’s surface. m in kg, g ≈ 9.8 N/kg, h in metres above a chosen zero. The zero is a bookkeeping choice.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Energy changes costume; the total in a closed account holds
domains.summary: Energy changes costume; the total in a closed account holds. Heat, sound, and deformation ‘lose’ useful energy from the motion account. Conservation is not ‘the machine stays.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Work is force along a displacement, a joule is a newton-metre
domains.summary: Work is force along a displacement, a joule is a newton-metre. W = Fd when force and movement align. Holding a brick still is tiring and still zero physics work on the brick.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Power is energy per time; a watt is a joule per second
domains.summary: Power is energy per time; a watt is a joule per second. A 60 W globe uses 60 J each second. A 2 kW kettle is not ‘stronger voltage’; it is a faster energy dump.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Insulation slows heat flow; R-value is a stubbornness rating
domains.summary: Insulation slows heat flow; R-value is a stubbornness rating. Heat still flows from hot to cold. Insulation is a thinner trickle. A gap of still air is often the trick.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Conduction is contact, convection is fluid movement, radiation is EM
domains.summary: Conduction is contact, convection is fluid movement, radiation is EM. A spoon in tea: conduction. Boiling water rolling: convection. Sun on skin: radiation. Vacuum stops the.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Series shares one current; parallel shares one voltage
domains.summary: Series shares one current; parallel shares one voltage. A series string of globes: one dies, the path dies. Parallel: branches. Household lights are parallel for a reason.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Voltage is energy per charge, a push, not a stuff that sits in the wire
domains.summary: Voltage is energy per charge, a push, not a stuff that sits in the wire. A 1.5 V cell gives 1.5 J per coulomb. Current is the flow rate of charge. You can have voltage with tiny.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Resistance is how much voltage you need per amp
domains.summary: Resistance is how much voltage you need per amp. R = V/I. A resistor is a designed bottleneck. Temperature can change R (filaments, thermistors).

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Wave speed is frequency times wavelength
domains.summary: Wave speed is frequency times wavelength. v = fλ. In one medium, raising f shortens λ if v is fixed. Sound in air is ~340 m/s, not ‘the speed of light’.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Transverse shakes perpendicular; longitudinal shakes along
domains.summary: Transverse shakes perpendicular; longitudinal shakes along. Light is transverse EM. Sound in air is longitudinal compressions. A slinky can do both if you are cruel.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Refraction is a speed change that can bend the path
domains.summary: Refraction is a speed change that can bend the path. Into a slower medium, the wave bends toward the normal (usual school case). Wavelength drops; frequency stays (steady source).

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Half-life is a waiting time for half the nuclei, not a half-dead sample vibe
domains.summary: Half-life is a waiting time for half the nuclei, not a half-dead sample vibe. After one half-life, half remain (on average, for large N). After two, a quarter. You cannot make a.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Nuclear energy changes are millions of times bigger per atom than chemical
domains.summary: Nuclear energy changes are millions of times bigger per atom than chemical. Chemistry moves electrons. Nuclear rearranges nuclei. That is why a tiny mass defect is a city-scale.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Producers fix energy; consumers eat; decomposers recycle
domains.summary: Producers fix energy; consumers eat; decomposers recycle. Plants and some bacteria photosynthesise or chemosynthesise. Arrows in a food chain point to the eater (energy flow),.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Photosynthesis and respiration are reverse-ish energy stories, not optional hobbies
domains.summary: Photosynthesis and respiration are reverse-ish energy stories, not optional hobbies. Photosynthesis stores light in sugar; respiration releases it to ATP. Plants respire too,.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Osmosis is water through a semi-permeable membrane, down its own gradient
domains.summary: Osmosis is water through a semi-permeable membrane, down its own gradient. Water moves to the saltier side (higher solute) in the simple tale. Cells in distilled water can burst;.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Diffusion is net movement from higher to lower concentration
domains.summary: Diffusion is net movement from higher to lower concentration. Particles still move at equilibrium; the net is zero. Temperature and gradient steepness change the rate.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A cell membrane is a selective gate, not a plastic bag
domains.summary: A cell membrane is a selective gate, not a plastic bag. Phospholipid bilayer plus proteins. Small nonpolar things sneak; ions need channels. ‘Semi-permeable’ is the school stamp.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Xylem is water up; phloem is sugar traffic
domains.summary: Xylem is water up; phloem is sugar traffic. Xylem: dead tubes, transpiration pull. Phloem: living tissue, sources to sinks. A ring-bark can kill by cutting phloem.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A keystone species punches above its biomass
domains.summary: A keystone species punches above its biomass. Sea otters, some dingoes in thought-experiments, a top predator that keeps grazers in check. Remove it, the web lurches.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Carrying capacity is a ceiling the habitat can support, not a vibe
domains.summary: Carrying capacity is a ceiling the habitat can support, not a vibe. Food, water, nesting, disease. A population can overshoot then crash. K is a model letter, not a fence you can.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A cane toad is an introduced predator/competitor with toxic skin
domains.summary: A cane toad is an introduced predator/competitor with toxic skin. Brought for cane beetles, spread anyway. Native predators that mouth them can die. Control is messy.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Nitrogen in air is mostly unusable until bacteria (or industry) fix it
domains.summary: Nitrogen in air is mostly unusable until bacteria (or industry) fix it. N₂ is triple-bonded and stubborn. Fixers, nitrifiers, denitrifiers. Fertilizer is industrial fixing. Algal.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Too much heat unfolds proteins; that is denaturation, not ‘killing the germ with spicy vibes’ only
domains.summary: Too much heat unfolds proteins; that is denaturation, not ‘killing the germ with spicy vibes’ only. Cooking an egg sets the white. Fever has limits. Enzymes have an optimum then.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A Punnett square is a probability map of gamete combinations
domains.summary: A Punnett square is a probability map of gamete combinations. Each parent’s alleles split. Boxes are equally likely if that is the model. 3:1 is a large-sample expectation, not a.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Natural selection is differential survival/reproduction of variants, not a species trying
domains.summary: Natural selection is differential survival/reproduction of variants, not a species trying. Variation, heritability, selection pressure. Giraffes do not stretch necks and pass on.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Biodiversity is genes, species, and ecosystems, not a zoo headcount only
domains.summary: Biodiversity is genes, species, and ecosystems, not a zoo headcount only. A wheat monoculture can have many plants and low diversity. A hotspot (SW Australia) is richness plus.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Cell theory is three claims, not ‘cells look boxy’
domains.summary: Cell theory is three claims, not ‘cells look boxy’. Living things are made of cells; cells are the basic unit; cells come from cells. Viruses pick a fight with the first two on.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Prokaryotes lack a nucleus; eukaryotes package DNA in one
domains.summary: Prokaryotes lack a nucleus; eukaryotes package DNA in one. Bacteria: prokaryote. Plants, animals, fungi, protists: eukaryote. Size and organelles differ. Prokaryote is not ‘worse’.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A tropism is a plant’s directed growth; a taxis is an animal’s directed move
domains.summary: A tropism is a plant’s directed growth; a taxis is an animal’s directed move. Phototropism: auxin story in shoots. Chemotaxis: bacteria swimming up a gradient. Both are stimulus.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Abiotic is the non-living stage; biotic is the living cast
domains.summary: Abiotic is the non-living stage; biotic is the living cast. Temperature, light, pH, salinity: abiotic. Competitors, predators, pathogens: biotic. A bushfire is a physical event.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Inertia is mass’s stubbornness, not a force you add to a diagram
domains.summary: Inertia is mass’s stubbornness, not a force you add to a diagram. Newton 1: constant velocity unless net force. A seatbelt is about inertia of your organs. Mass is the measure,.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Action–reaction pairs are on two bodies, not a cancel on one
domains.summary: Action–reaction pairs are on two bodies, not a cancel on one. You push the water back; the water pushes you forward. They do not cancel because they do not act on the same object.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Floating is density and displaced weight, not ‘being light as a personality’
domains.summary: Floating is density and displaced weight, not ‘being light as a personality’. If average density < fluid, it floats. A steel ship is mostly air. Ice is less dense than liquid.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Each pH unit is a tenfold H⁺ change, not a one-step sour
domains.summary: Each pH unit is a tenfold H⁺ change, not a one-step sour. pH 2 vs 3 is 10×, not ‘a bit’. pH 7 is neutral in the water story at usual T. Indicators are dyes with a range, not a.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Pressure is force over area, why a sharp knife cuts
domains.summary: Pressure is force over area, why a sharp knife cuts. P = F/A. Same force, smaller area, bigger pressure. Snowshoes are the opposite trick. Pascals are N/m².

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Hooke’s law is F = kx in the elastic range, not forever
domains.summary: Hooke’s law is F = kx in the elastic range, not forever. Double extension, double force, until you pass the limit and the spring sulks. k is stiffness, not ‘how long the spring.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: The EM spectrum is one family: radio to gamma, same c in vacuum
domains.summary: The EM spectrum is one family: radio to gamma, same c in vacuum. Energy and frequency climb together; wavelength drops. Visible is a sliver. UV is not ‘strong light’ as a brand;.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A convex lens converges; a concave diverges (in the usual glass-in-air case)
domains.summary: A convex lens converges; a concave diverges (in the usual glass-in-air case). Ray diagrams: parallel → focal point for convex. The eye’s lens is a living convex story. A camera.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Chloroplasts bank light; mitochondria release it to ATP
domains.summary: Chloroplasts bank light; mitochondria release it to ATP. Plant cells usually have both. Animal cells have mitochondria, not chloroplasts. The endosymbiosis story is a later wow.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Stomata are adjustable pores: CO₂ in, water vapour out
domains.summary: Stomata are adjustable pores: CO₂ in, water vapour out. Guard cells open/close. Hot windy days can close to save water and then starve photosynthesis of CO₂. A trade.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Pollination is pollen to stigma; fertilisation is fusion; a seed is the sequel
domains.summary: Pollination is pollen to stigma; fertilisation is fusion; a seed is the sequel. Wind vs animal pollination are different offers. Fruit is often a bribe for seed travel. They are.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Succession is a community changing through time after a disturbance
domains.summary: Succession is a community changing through time after a disturbance. Primary (bare rock) vs secondary (soil left). Pioneer species, then later trees in the textbook cartoon. Real.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A vector has size and direction; a scalar is size only
domains.summary: A vector has size and direction; a scalar is size only. Displacement, velocity, force, momentum: vectors. Distance, speed, mass, time: scalars. 3 m north is not 3 m.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: A moment is force times perpendicular distance from the pivot
domains.summary: A moment is force times perpendicular distance from the pivot. M = Fd⊥. A longer spanner is not a stronger person; it is a bigger d. Clockwise vs anticlockwise balance.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: Specific heat capacity is joules to lift 1 kg by 1°C
domains.summary: Specific heat capacity is joules to lift 1 kg by 1°C. Water’s high c is why oceans moderate climate and why a pot takes ages. Q = mcΔT in the school form.

domains.subject: science
domains.title: The rock cycle is a set of paths, not a compulsory circle
domains.summary: The rock cycle is a set of paths, not a compulsory circle. Melt → igneous; weather/deposit → sedimentary; heat/pressure → metamorphic. A rock can skip the scenic route.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: An anachronism is a time-travelling object in the story
domains.summary: An anachronism is a time-travelling object in the story. A wristwatch on a Roman statue is a tell. So is expecting a 1788 governor to tweet. Chronology is a skill, not a vibe.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: Presentism is judging them only by our current kit
domains.summary: Presentism is judging them only by our current kit. People in 1850 did not have germ theory as a public habit. You can still name harm. The skill is reconstructing their.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: A turning point is a hinge; a trend is a slope
domains.summary: A turning point is a hinge; a trend is a slope. 1945 can be a hinge for empires and a continuation of industrial killing. You need to say for whom and for what.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: Agency is a person pushing; structure is the room they are in
domains.summary: Agency is a person pushing; structure is the room they are in. A union secretary and a wool price and a racist statute can all be in one strike story. ‘Great men’ vs ‘impersonal.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: Intended policy and side effects are different tickets
domains.summary: Intended policy and side effects are different tickets. White Australia intended a racial labour market. It also shaped who could be a neighbour. Unintended is not ‘accidental.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: A local story and a world story can share a date and not a meaning
domains.summary: A local story and a world story can share a date and not a meaning. A 1930s dole riot in Sydney and a 1930s German election are both ‘Depression’ only at a high zoom. Scale is a.

domains.subject: history
domains.title: Significance is a claim: remarkable, remembered, resulting, revealing
